"""公开门面：:class:`MetaCatalog`。

组合注册簿、Schema 校验、字段级比较、影响分析与全文检索。所有成功结果都以
普通 dict/list 返回（可直接 JSON 序列化）；注册、比较、读取与检索均不会改动
既有 Schema 的注册内容、版本关系与资产依赖关系。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
from typing import Any

from . import compare as compare_mod
from . import schema_fields as sf
from . import upgrade as upgrade_mod
from .errors import NotFoundError, SchemaComparisonInvalid
from .impact import analyze_field
from .registry import FieldRef, Registry
from .search import SearchIndex
from .validator import validate_schema


class MetaCatalog:
    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self._registry = Registry()
        self._index = SearchIndex()
        self._reports: dict[str, dict[str, Any]] = {}
        self._indexed_reports: set[str] = set()

    # ============================================================ 注册：Schema
    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册一个不可变的 Schema 版本。文档不合法时抛 SchemaComparisonInvalid。"""
        validate_schema(document)
        record = self._registry.register_schema(name, version, document)
        self._index_schema(record.name, record.version, record.document, record.title)
        return self.get_schema(name, version)

    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        record = self._registry.get_schema(name, version)
        return {
            "name": record.name,
            "version": record.version,
            "title": record.title,
            "document": copy.deepcopy(record.document),
        }

    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
        return self._registry.list_versions(name)

    # ============================================================== 注册：资产
    def register_asset(
        self,
        asset_id: str,
        name: str,
        kind: str,
        refs: list[dict[str, Any]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """注册目录资产。

        ``refs`` 为 ``[{"schema": 名, "version": 版本, "path": 字段指针}, ...]``，
        表示资产对字段的直接引用；路径可写文档指针（``/properties/a``）或
        逻辑字段路径（``/a``），注册时统一规整。
        """
        asset = self._registry.register_asset(asset_id, name, kind, refs or [])
        self._index_asset(asset.id, asset.name, asset.kind, list(asset.refs))
        return self._asset_view(asset)

    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return self._asset_view(self._registry.get_asset(asset_id))

    @staticmethod
    def _asset_view(asset) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "asset_id": asset.id,
            "name": asset.name,
            "kind": asset.kind,
            "refs": [
                {"schema": r.schema, "version": r.version, "path": r.path}
                for r in asset.refs
            ],
        }

    # ================================================================ 影响分析
    def analyze_impact(self, name: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """字段级影响分析：返回直接引用资产与经其他 Schema 传递引用的资产。"""
        return analyze_field(self._registry, name, version, path)

    # ======================================================== 字段级变更识别
    def compare_schemas(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """比较基线版本与候选文档，生成并入库可检索的字段级变更报告。

        ``candidate`` 直接给出候选 JSON Schema 文档；或省略它、仅传
        ``candidate_version`` 以引用同 Schema 标识下已注册的候选版本。
        ``renames`` 为 ``[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]``。

        任何不合法情形统一抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        相同输入返回相同报告（幂等，不会重复入库）。
        """
        # 1) 解析候选文档与基线版本。
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )

        # 2) 生成报告（重命名校验在其中完成）。
        report = compare_mod.build_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
        )

        # 3) 幂等入库并进入全文检索范围。
        report_id = report["report_id"]
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            self._reports[report_id] = report
        if report_id not in self._indexed_reports:
            for i, change in enumerate(report["changes"]):
                self._index_change(report, change, i)
            self._indexed_reports.add(report_id)
        return copy.deepcopy(report)

    def _resolve_comparison_inputs(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any,
        candidate_version: str | None,
    ) -> tuple[Any, str | None]:
        """解析并校验比较输入：候选文档（深拷贝）与候选版本标签、基线版本存在性。

        校验口径与 :meth:`compare_schemas` 完全一致，失败时抛
        :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。
        """
        if candidate is None:
            if candidate_version is None:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    "必须提供候选文档 candidate 或已注册的 candidate_version",
                    details={"reason": "candidate_missing"},
                )
            try:
                candidate_record = self._registry.get_schema(name, candidate_version)
            except NotFoundError as exc:
                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                    f"指定版本 {name}@{candidate_version} 不存在",
                    details={"reason": "version_not_found", **exc.details},
                ) from exc
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate_record.document)
            label = candidate_version
        else:
            validate_schema(candidate)
            candidate_document = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
            label = candidate_version  # 允许调用方给候选文档附带版本标签

        if not self._registry.has_schema(name, baseline_version):
            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
                f"指定版本 {name}@{baseline_version} 不存在",
                details={"reason": "version_not_found", "schema": name, "version": baseline_version},
            )
        return candidate_document, label

    # ============================================================ 升级影响汇总
    def analyze_upgrade_impact(
        self,
        name: str,
        baseline_version: str,
        candidate: Any = None,
        *,
        candidate_version: str | None = None,
        renames: list[dict[str, str]] | list[list[str]] | None = None,
        asset_ids: list[str] | None = None,
    ) -> dict[str, Any]:
        """汇总一次升级对目录资产的影响（按资产维度的字段级变更视图）。

        候选文档、候选版本、重命名映射与字段路径语义与
        :meth:`compare_schemas` 一致；``report_id`` 与相同输入的
        ``compare_schemas`` 相同。

        ``asset_ids`` 为 ``None`` 时覆盖全部资产；指定时去重且不考虑顺序，
        只覆盖所列资产，未知资产抛 :class:`NotFoundError`。

        本调用为只读操作：不注册候选文档、不生成/改动变更报告、不写入检索
        索引；既有的读取、比较、影响分析与检索行为保持不变。
        """
        candidate_document, label = self._resolve_comparison_inputs(
            name, baseline_version, candidate, candidate_version
        )
        summary = upgrade_mod.build_upgrade_report(
            self._registry,
            name,
            baseline_version,
            candidate_document,
            label,
            renames,
            asset_ids,
        )
        return copy.deepcopy(summary)

    def get_report(self, report_id: str) -> dict[str, Any]:
        if report_id not in self._reports:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"变更报告 {report_id} 不存在", details={"report_id": report_id}
            )
        return copy.deepcopy(self._reports[report_id])

    def list_reports(
        self, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
    ) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """列出报告摘要（可按 Schema 名称与版本过滤，版本匹配基线或候选）。"""
        out = []
        for rid in sorted(self._reports):
            r = self._reports[rid]
            if name is not None and r["schema"] != name:
                continue
            if version is not None and version not in (
                r["baseline_version"],
                r["candidate_version"],
            ):
                continue
            out.append(
                {
                    "report_id": r["report_id"],
                    "schema": r["schema"],
                    "baseline_version": r["baseline_version"],
                    "candidate_version": r["candidate_version"],
                    "summary": r["summary"],
                }
            )
        return out

    # ================================================================== 检索
    def search(self, keyword: str | None = None, **filters: Any) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """组合检索 Schema / 资产 / 字段变更。

        可选过滤：``schema``、``version``、``field_path``、``change_kind``、
        ``compatibility``、``asset_name``、``doc_type``、``limit``。
        返回命中条目（含命中字段与命中资产摘要），排序稳定，与插入顺序无关。
        """
        return self._index.search(keyword, **filters)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------ 索引维护
    def _index_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any, title: str | None) -> None:
        fields = sf.expand(document)
        root = fields.get("")
        description = ""
        if root is not None:
            d = root.schema.get("description")
            description = d if isinstance(d, str) else ""
        text_fields = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title or "",
            "description": description,
            "field_paths": "\n".join(sorted(fields)),
        }
        payload = {
            "name": name,
            "version": version,
            "title": title,
            "summary": {
                "name": name,
                "version": version,
                "title": title,
                "field_count": len(fields),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc(
            "schema", ("schema", name, version), text_fields, payload
        )

    def _index_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, kind: str, refs: list[FieldRef]) -> None:
        schemas = sorted({r.schema for r in refs})
        versions = sorted({f"{r.schema}@{r.version}" for r in refs})
        text_fields = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "refs": "\n".join(f"{r.schema}@{r.version}{r.path}" for r in refs),
        }
        payload = {
            "id": asset_id,
            "name": name,
            "kind": kind,
            "schemas": schemas,
            "versions": versions,
            "summary": {
                "asset_id": asset_id,
                "name": name,
                "kind": kind,
                "ref_count": len(refs),
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc("asset", ("asset", asset_id), text_fields, payload)

    def _index_change(self, report: dict[str, Any], change: dict[str, Any], seq: int) -> None:
        direct = change["direct_assets"]
        transitive = change["transitive_assets"]
        impacted: dict[str, str] = {}
        for a in direct:
            impacted[a["asset_id"]] = a["name"]
        for a in transitive:
            impacted.setdefault(a["asset_id"], a["name"])

        asset_text = "\n".join(sorted(impacted.values()))
        asset_id_text = "\n".join(sorted(impacted))
        summary_text = _summary_text(change["old_summary"]) + "\n" + _summary_text(
            change["new_summary"]
        )
        text_fields = {
            "schema": report["schema"],
            "version": " ".join(
                v for v in (report["baseline_version"], report["candidate_version"]) if v
            ),
            "field_path": "\n".join(
                p for p in (change["old_path"], change["new_path"], change["path"]) if p
            ),
            "change_kind": change["change_kind"],
            "compatibility": change["compatibility"],
            "impact_assets": asset_text,
            "impact_asset_ids": asset_id_text,
            "summary": summary_text,
        }
        key = (
            "change",
            report["schema"],
            report["baseline_version"],
            report["candidate_version"] or "",
            report["report_id"],
            change["path"],
            change["old_path"] or "",
            change["change_kind"],
            seq,
        )
        payload = {
            "report_id": report["report_id"],
            "schema": report["schema"],
            "baseline_version": report["baseline_version"],
            "candidate_version": report["candidate_version"],
            "path": change["path"],
            "old_path": change["old_path"],
            "new_path": change["new_path"],
            "change_kind": change["change_kind"],
            "compatibility": change["compatibility"],
            "old_summary": change["old_summary"],
            "new_summary": change["new_summary"],
            "matched_assets": [
                {"asset_id": aid, "name": impacted[aid]} for aid in sorted(impacted)
            ],
            "direct_assets": direct,
            "transitive_assets": transitive,
            "summary": {
                "report_id": report["report_id"],
                "schema": report["schema"],
                "path": change["path"],
                "change_kind": change["change_kind"],
                "compatibility": change["compatibility"],
                "assets": [
                    {"asset_id": aid, "name": impacted[aid]} for aid in sorted(impacted)
                ],
            },
        }
        self._index.add_doc("change", key, text_fields, payload)


def _summary_text(summary: dict[str, Any] | None) -> str:
    if not summary:
        return ""
    parts: list[str] = []
    for key, value in summary.items():
        parts.append(f"{key}={_flatten(value)}")
    return "\n".join(parts)


def _flatten(value: Any) -> str:
    if isinstance(value, (dict, list)):
        import json

        return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
    return str(value)

1	"""字段路径工具。
2	
3	字段路径采用 JSON Pointer（RFC 6901）表示，例如 ``/properties/name``、
4	``/properties/a~1b``。根对象本身用空串 ``""`` 表示。
5	"""
6	
7	from __future__ import annotations
8	
9	from typing import Any
10	
11	
12	def escape(token: str) -> str:
13	    """转义单个路径段。"""
14	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
15	
16	
17	def unescape(token: str) -> str:
18	    """反转义单个路径段。"""
19	    return token.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
20	
21	
22	def parse(path: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
23	    """把 JSON Pointer 解析为路径段元组；根路径返回空元组。"""
24	    if path == "":
25	        return ()
26	    if not path.startswith("/"):
27	        raise ValueError(f"非法 JSON Pointer: {path!r}")
28	    return tuple(unescape(seg) for seg in path[1:].split("/"))
29	
30	
31	def format(segments: tuple[str, ...] | list[str]) -> str:
32	    """把路径段组装为 JSON Pointer。"""
33	    return "".join("/" + escape(str(seg)) for seg in segments)
34	
35	
36	def child(path: str, segment: str) -> str:
37	    """返回某路径下的子路径。"""
38	    return (path + "/" + escape(segment)) if path else "/" + escape(segment)
39	
40	
41	def parent(path: str) -> str | None:
42	    """返回父路径；根路径返回 ``None``。"""
43	    segs = parse(path)
44	    if not segs:
45	        return None
46	    return format(segs[:-1])
47	
48	
49	def is_under(prefix: str, path: str) -> bool:
50	    """``path`` 是否位于 ``prefix`` 子树内（含自身）。"""
51	    p, c = parse(prefix), parse(path)
52	    return len(c) >= len(p) and c[: len(p)] == p
53	
54	
55	def resolve(doc: Any, path: str) -> Any:
56	    """在文档中按 JSON Pointer 取值，缺段/越界/类型不符时抛 KeyError。"""
57	    cur: Any = doc
58	    for seg in parse(path):
59	        if isinstance(cur, dict):
60	            if seg not in cur:
61	                raise KeyError(path)
62	            cur = cur[seg]
63	        elif isinstance(cur, list):
64	            try:
65	                idx = int(seg)
66	            except ValueError as exc:
67	                raise KeyError(path) from exc
68	            if not 0 <= idx < len(cur):
69	                raise KeyError(path)
70	            cur = cur[idx]
71	        else:
72	            raise KeyError(path)
73	    return cur
74	
75	
76	def normalize_field_pointer(path: str) -> str:
77	    """把 Schema 文档指针 *无上下文地* 规整为逻辑字段路径。
78	
79	    注意：纯文本规整无法区分「名为 ``items`` 的属性」与 ``items`` 关键字，
80	    资产/引用路径应优先使用逻辑路径，或用 :func:`resolve_logical` 结合
81	    文档解析。
82	    """
83	    segs = list(parse(path))
84	    out: list[str] = []
85	    for i, seg in enumerate(segs):
86	        if seg in ("properties", "prefixItems"):
87	            continue
88	        if seg == "additionalProperties":
89	            out.append("*")
90	        elif seg == "items":
91	            # 元组形式 items/0 展开为数组下标；单 Schema items 展开为 -。
92	            if i + 1 < len(segs) and segs[i + 1].isdigit():
93	                continue
94	            out.append("-")
95	        else:
96	            out.append(seg)
97	    return format(out)
98	
99	
100	def resolve_logical(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str | None:
101	    """结合文档结构，把文档指针解析为逻辑字段路径；不可解析返回 ``None``。
102	
103	    遍历规则与字段展开一致：``properties`` 段省略（其后必为属性名，即使
104	    名字恰好叫 ``items``）；单 Schema ``items`` 段映射为 ``-``；
105	    ``additionalProperties`` 映射为 ``*``；``$defs``/``definitions`` 保留。
106	    """
107	    segs = parse(raw_path)
108	    node: Any = document
109	    logical: list[str] = []
110	    i = 0
111	    while i < len(segs):
112	        seg = segs[i]
113	        if isinstance(node, dict):
114	            props = node.get("properties")
115	            if seg == "properties" and isinstance(props, dict):
116	                # 容器关键字与其后的属性名在同一步消费，避免属性名与
117	                # Schema 关键字（如名为 items 的属性）混淆。
118	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
119	                    return None
120	                name = segs[i + 1]
121	                if name not in props:
122	                    return None
123	                node = props[name]
124	                logical.append(name)
125	                i += 2
126	                continue
127	            pats = node.get("patternProperties")
128	            if seg == "patternProperties" and isinstance(pats, dict):
129	                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
130	                    return None
131	                name = segs[i + 1]
132	                if name not in pats:
133	                    return None
134	                node = pats[name]
135	                logical.append(escape(name))
136	                i += 2
137	                continue
138	            ap = node.get("additionalProperties")
139	            if seg == "additionalProperties" and isinstance(ap, (dict, bool)):
140	                node = ap
141	                logical.append("*")
142	                i += 1
143	                continue
144	            items = node.get("items")
145	            if seg == "items" and isinstance(items, (dict, bool)):

161	                logical.append(str(idx))
162	                i += 2
163	                continue
164	            if seg in ("$defs", "definitions") and isinstance(node.get(seg), dict):

1	"""注册簿：Schema 版本、目录资产与跨 Schema 引用关系。
2	
3	注册内容不可变：任何读取都返回深拷贝，比较、影响分析和检索都无法改动
4	既有注册结果、版本关系与资产依赖关系。
5	
6	跨 Schema 引用约定：``$ref`` 写作 ``"<SchemaName>@<version>#<JSONPointer>"``，
7	例如 ``"Address@1.0#/properties/street"``；``#`` 后为空表示引用文档根。
8	文档内引用沿用标准 ``"#/..."`` 形式。
9	"""
10	
11	from __future__ import annotations
12	
13	import copy
14	import re
15	from dataclasses import dataclass
16	from typing import Any
17	
18	from .errors import AlreadyExistsError, NotFoundError
19	from . import pointer as ptr
20	from .schema_fields import expand as _expand_fields
21	
22	_REF_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>[^@#/\s]+)@(?P<version>[^@#\s]+)#(?P<pointer>.*)$")
23	_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9_.\-]+$")
24	
25	
26	def validate_name(name: str, *, what: str = "名称") -> None:
27	    if not isinstance(name, str) or not name or not _NAME_RE.match(name):
28	        raise ValueError(f"非法{what}: {name!r}（只允许字母、数字、_、.、-）")
29	
30	
31	@dataclass(frozen=True)
32	class SchemaVersion:
33	    name: str
34	    version: str
35	    document: Any
36	    title: str | None
37	
38	
39	@dataclass(frozen=True)
40	class FieldRef:
41	    """资产对某 Schema 某版本某字段路径的直接引用。"""
42	
43	    schema: str
44	    version: str
45	    path: str  # JSON Pointer，"" 表示根
46	
47	
48	@dataclass(frozen=True)
49	class Asset:
50	    id: str
51	    name: str
52	    kind: str
53	    refs: tuple[FieldRef, ...]
54	
55	
56	@dataclass(frozen=True)
57	class RefEdge:
58	    """一条跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边：src 字段定义引用了 dst 字段节点。"""
59	
60	    src_schema: str
61	    src_version: str
62	    src_path: str
63	    dst_schema: str
64	    dst_version: str
65	    dst_path: str
66	
67	
68	def parse_external_ref(ref: str) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
69	    """解析跨 Schema 引用；非此外部形式返回 ``None``。"""
70	    m = _REF_RE.match(ref)
71	    if not m:
72	        return None
73	    return m.group("name"), m.group("version"), m.group("pointer")
74	
75	
76	def extract_ref_edges(name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> list[RefEdge]:
77	    """提取文档内全部跨 Schema 引用边（原始文档指针，按出现顺序排序）。
78	
79	    指针在注册时再结合两端文档解析为逻辑字段路径。
80	    """
81	    edges: list[RefEdge] = []
82	
83	    def walk(node: Any, path: str, seen: frozenset[int]) -> None:
84	        if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
85	            return
86	        if id(node) in seen:
87	            return
88	        seen = seen | {id(node)}
89	        if isinstance(node, dict):
90	            ref = node.get("$ref")
91	            if isinstance(ref, str):
92	                parsed = parse_external_ref(ref)
93	                if parsed is not None:
94	                    dst_name, dst_version, fragment = parsed
95	                    if fragment and not fragment.startswith("/"):
96	                        fragment = "/" + fragment
97	                    edges.append(
98	                        RefEdge(name, version, path, dst_name, dst_version, fragment)
99	                    )
100	            for k in sorted(node.keys()):
101	                walk(node[k], path + "/" + _escape(k) if path else "/" + _escape(k), seen)
102	        else:
103	            for i, v in enumerate(node):
104	                walk(v, f"{path}/{i}" if path else f"/{i}", seen)
105	
106	    walk(document, "", frozenset())
107	    edges.sort(key=lambda e: (e.src_path, e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.dst_path))
108	    return edges
109	
110	
111	def _escape(token: str) -> str:
112	    return token.replace("~", "~0").replace("/", "~1")
113	
114	
115	class Registry:
116	    def __init__(self) -> None:
117	        self._schemas: dict[tuple[str, str], SchemaVersion] = {}
118	        # name -> 按注册顺序保存的版本列表
119	        self._versions: dict[str, list[str]] = {}
120	        self._assets: dict[str, Asset] = {}
121	        self._edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[RefEdge, ...]] = {}
122	
123	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ schema
124	    def register_schema(self, name: str, version: str, document: Any) -> SchemaVersion:
125	        validate_name(name, what="Schema 名称")
126	        validate_name(version, what="版本号")
127	        key = (name, version)
128	        if key in self._schemas:
129	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
130	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 已注册，注册内容不可覆盖",
131	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
132	            )
133	        # 跨 Schema 引用允许前向（目标稍后注册），因此引用环也可注册；
134	        # 目标缺失或目标字段不存在时，影响传播自然不会产生命中。
135	        raw_edges = extract_ref_edges(name, version, document)
136	        edges: list[RefEdge] = []
137	        for e in raw_edges:
138	            dst_record = self._schemas.get((e.dst_schema, e.dst_version))
139	            dst_raw = e.dst_path if e.dst_path else ""
140	            if dst_record is not None:
141	                dst_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(dst_record.document, dst_raw)
142	                if dst_logical is None or dst_logical not in _expand_fields(dst_record.document):
143	                    # 目标已注册但字段不存在：属于确定的非法引用。
144	                    raise NotFoundError(
145	                        f"跨 Schema 引用 {e.dst_schema}@{e.dst_version}{dst_raw} 的目标字段不存在",
146	                        details={
147	                            "schema": e.dst_schema,
148	                            "version": e.dst_version,
149	                            "path": dst_raw,
150	                        },
151	                    )
152	                final_dst = dst_logical
153	            else:
154	                final_dst = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(dst_raw)
155	            src_logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, e.src_path)
156	            edges.append(
157	                RefEdge(
158	                    name,
159	                    version,
160	                    src_logical or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(e.src_path),
161	                    e.dst_schema,
162	                    e.dst_version,
163	                    final_dst,
164	                )
165	            )
166	        edges.sort(key=lambda x: (x.src_path, x.dst_schema, x.dst_version, x.dst_path))
167	        title = None
168	        if isinstance(document, dict):
169	            t = document.get("title")
170	            title = t if isinstance(t, str) else None
171	        record = SchemaVersion(name, version, copy.deepcopy(document), title)
172	        self._schemas[key] = record
173	        self._versions.setdefault(name, []).append(version)
174	        self._edges[key] = tuple(edges)
175	        return record
176	
177	    def get_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> SchemaVersion:
178	        key = (name, version)
179	        if key not in self._schemas:
180	            raise NotFoundError(
181	                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
182	                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
183	            )
184	        return self._schemas[key]
185	
186	    def has_schema(self, name: str, version: str) -> bool:
187	        return (name, version) in self._schemas
188	
189	    def schema_document(self, name: str, version: str) -> Any:
190	        return copy.deepcopy(self.get_schema(name, version).document)
191	
192	    def list_versions(self, name: str) -> list[str]:
193	        if name not in self._versions:
194	            raise NotFoundError(f"Schema {name} 不存在", details={"schema": name})
195	        return list(self._versions[name])
196	
197	    def edges(self, name: str, version: str) -> tuple[RefEdge, ...]:
198	        return self._edges.get((name, version), ())
199	
200	    def all_edges(self) -> list[RefEdge]:
201	        out: list[RefEdge] = []
202	        for key in sorted(self._edges):
203	            out.extend(self._edges[key])
204	        return out
205	
206	    def all_schemas(self) -> list[SchemaVersion]:
207	        return [self._schemas[k] for k in sorted(self._schemas)]
208	
209	    def _logical_path_exists(
210	        self, schema: str, version: str, path: str, stack: frozenset[tuple[str, str]]
211	    ) -> bool:
212	        """判断逻辑字段路径是否可达，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析。"""
213	        if (schema, version) not in self._schemas:
214	            return False
215	        document = self._schemas[(schema, version)].document
216	        valid_paths = _expand_fields(document)
217	        if path in valid_paths:
218	            return True
219	
220	        target_segs = ptr.parse(path)
221	        # 选择最长的、能覆盖目标路径前缀的出边。
222	        best = None
223	        for edge in self._edges.get((schema, version), ()):  # type: RefEdge
224	            esegs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
225	            if len(esegs) <= len(target_segs) and target_segs[: len(esegs)] == esegs:
226	                if best is None or len(esegs) > len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)):
227	                    best = edge
228	        if best is None:
229	            return False
230	        dst_key = (best.dst_schema, best.dst_version)
231	        if dst_key in stack:
232	            return False
233	        suffix = target_segs[len(ptr.parse(best.src_path)) :]
234	        resolved = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(best.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
235	        return self._logical_path_exists(
236	            best.dst_schema, best.dst_version, resolved, stack | {dst_key}
237	        )
238	
239	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------- asset
240	    def register_asset(
241	        self,
242	        asset_id: str,
243	        name: str,
244	        kind: str,
245	        refs: list[FieldRef] | list[dict] | None = None,
246	    ) -> Asset:
247	        validate_name(asset_id, what="资产标识")
248	        if not isinstance(name, str) or not name:
249	            raise ValueError("资产名称必须是非空字符串")
250	        if not isinstance(kind, str) or not kind:
251	            raise ValueError("资产类型必须是非空字符串")
252	        if asset_id in self._assets:
253	            raise AlreadyExistsError(
254	                f"资产 {asset_id} 已注册", details={"asset": asset_id}
255	            )
256	
257	        normalized: list[FieldRef] = []
258	        seen: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = set()
259	        for raw in refs or []:
260	            if isinstance(raw, FieldRef):
261	                r = raw
262	            else:
263	                r = FieldRef(raw["schema"], str(raw["version"]), raw.get("path", ""))
264	            validate_name(r.schema, what="引用 Schema 名称")
265	            record = self.get_schema(r.schema, r.version)
266	            if r.path and not r.path.startswith("/"):
267	                raise ValueError(f"资产引用字段路径必须是 JSON Pointer: {r.path!r}")
268	            candidate_paths = []
269	            contextual = ptr.resolve_logical(record.document, r.path)
270	            if contextual is not None:
271	                candidate_paths.append(contextual)
272	            text_normalized = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(r.path)
273	            for cand in (text_normalized, r.path):
274	                if cand not in candidate_paths:
275	                    candidate_paths.append(cand)
276	
277	            resolved_path = next(
278	                (
279	                    cand
280	                    for cand in candidate_paths
281	                    if self._logical_path_exists(
282	                        r.schema, r.version, cand, frozenset({(r.schema, r.version)})
283	                    )
284	                ),
285	                None,
286	            )
287	            if resolved_path is None:
288	                raise NotFoundError(
289	                    f"资产引用的字段 {r.schema}@{r.version}{text_normalized} 不存在",
290	                    details={
291	                        "schema": r.schema,
292	                        "version": r.version,
293	                        "path": text_normalized,
294	                    },
295	                )
296	            r = FieldRef(r.schema, r.version, resolved_path)
297	            dedup_key = (r.schema, r.version, r.path)
298	            if dedup_key in seen:
299	                continue
300	            seen.add(dedup_key)
301	            normalized.append(r)
302	
303	        normalized.sort(key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
304	        asset = Asset(asset_id, name, kind, tuple(normalized))
305	        self._assets[asset_id] = asset
306	        return asset
307	
308	    def get_asset(self, asset_id: str) -> Asset:
309	        if asset_id not in self._assets:
310	            raise NotFoundError(f"资产 {asset_id} 不存在", details={"asset": asset_id})
311	        return self._assets[asset_id]
312	
313	    def all_assets(self) -> list[Asset]:
314	        return [self._assets[k] for k in sorted(self._assets)]

1	"""把 JSON Schema 展开为扁平字段表，并给出字段特征。
2	
3	只展开业务字段所在的容器：根节点、``properties``、``$defs``/``definitions``
4	里的对象、以及 ``items``/``prefixItems``/``additionalProperties`` 等容器层。
5	``allOf``/``anyOf``/``oneOf`` 等组合子节点不参与字段路径比较（避免同一逻辑
6	字段出现多重路径），但其 ``required`` 约束会被合并到所在对象节点。
7	"""
8	
9	from __future__ import annotations
10	
11	import json
12	from typing import Any
13	
14	from . import pointer as ptr
15	
16	# 纯注解关键字：只调整这些时归类为 metadata。
17	ANNOTATION_KEYS = ("title", "description", "$comment")
18	
19	# 结构关键字（参与兼容判定）。顺序同时决定摘要输出顺序，保证确定性。
20	STRUCTURAL_KEYS = (
21	    "type",
22	    "enum",
23	    "const",
24	    "required",
25	    "default",
26	    "format",
27	    "minimum",
28	    "maximum",
29	    "exclusiveMinimum",
30	    "exclusiveMaximum",
31	    "multipleOf",
32	    "minLength",
33	    "maxLength",
34	    "pattern",
35	    "minItems",
36	    "maxItems",
37	    "uniqueItems",
38	    "minProperties",
39	    "maxProperties",
40	)
41	
42	# 嵌套容器关键字：不在同路径字段比较范围内，由子字段条目负责。
43	CONTAINER_KEYS = frozenset(
44	    {
45	        "properties",
46	        "patternProperties",
47	        "additionalProperties",
48	        "items",
49	        "prefixItems",
50	        "contains",
51	        "allOf",
52	        "anyOf",
53	        "oneOf",
54	        "not",
55	        "$defs",
56	        "definitions",
57	        "$ref",
58	        "propertyNames",
59	        "unevaluatedProperties",
60	        "unevaluatedItems",
61	    }
62	)
63	
64	# 放宽/收窄判定关心的数值边界关键字。
65	_BOUND_KEYS = (
66	    "minimum",
67	    "maximum",
68	    "exclusiveMinimum",
69	    "exclusiveMaximum",
70	    "minLength",
71	    "maxLength",
72	    "minItems",
73	    "maxItems",
74	    "minProperties",
75	    "maxProperties",
76	    "pattern",
77	    "format",
78	    "multipleOf",
79	    "uniqueItems",

83	class Field:
84	    """一个展开后的字段节点。
85	
86	    :ivar path: 字段的 JSON Pointer 路径。
87	    :ivar schema: 该字段的生效 Schema 片段（已合并 allOf/required）。
88	    :ivar required_paths: 该对象节点直接要求必填的子字段路径集合。
89	    """
90	
91	    __slots__ = ("path", "schema", "required_paths")
92	
93	    def __init__(self, path: str, schema: dict, required_paths: frozenset[str]):
94	        self.path = path
95	        self.schema = schema
96	        self.required_paths = required_paths
97	
98	
99	def _effective(node: dict) -> dict:
100	    """返回字段的生效定义：合并 allOf 的结构关键字与 required。
101	
102	    不改变原节点；不递归 anyOf/oneOf（分支为可选，不构成确定约束）。
103	    """
104	    merged: dict[str, Any] = {k: v for k, v in node.items() if k != "allOf"}
105	    required: list[Any] = list(node.get("required", []))
106	    for sub in node.get("allOf", []) or []:
107	        if not isinstance(sub, dict):
108	            continue
109	        for k, v in sub.items():
110	            if k == "required":
111	                required.extend(v)
112	            elif k == "allOf":
113	                continue
114	            elif k not in merged:
115	                merged[k] = v
116	    if required:
117	        # 去重但保持稳定顺序。
118	        seen: set[str] = set()
119	        uniq = []
120	        for r in required:
121	            if r not in seen:
122	                seen.add(r)
123	                uniq.append(r)
124	        merged["required"] = uniq
125	    return merged
126	
127	
128	def expand(document: Any) -> dict[str, Field]:
129	    """把文档展开为 ``{path: Field}``。"""
130	    fields: dict[str, Field] = {}
131	    if isinstance(document, bool):
132	        fields[""] = Field("", {} if document else {}, frozenset())
133	        return fields
134	
135	    def add(path: str, raw: Any) -> None:
136	        if isinstance(raw, bool):
137	            raw = {} if raw else {"not": {}}
138	        eff = _effective(raw)
139	        req = frozenset(
140	            ptr.child(path, name)
141	            for name in eff.get("required", [])
142	            if isinstance(name, str)
143	        )
144	        fields[path] = Field(path, eff, req)
145	
146	    def walk(node: Any, path: str, seen: frozenset[int]) -> None:
147	        if isinstance(node, bool):
148	            add(path, node)
149	            return
150	        if not isinstance(node, dict):
151	            return
152	        if id(node) in seen:
153	            return
154	        seen = seen | {id(node)}
155	
156	        add(path, node)
157	        eff = fields[path].schema
158	
159	        for name in sorted(eff.get("properties", {}).keys()):
160	            walk(eff["properties"][name], ptr.child(path, name), seen)
161	
162	        for def_kw in ("$defs", "definitions"):
163	            defs = eff.get(def_kw)
164	            if isinstance(defs, dict):
165	                for dname in sorted(defs.keys()):
166	                    sub = defs[dname]
167	                    if isinstance(sub, dict) or isinstance(sub, bool):
168	                        walk(sub, ptr.child(ptr.child(path, def_kw), dname), seen)
169	
170	        items = eff.get("items")
171	        if isinstance(items, dict):
172	            walk(items, ptr.child(path, "-"), seen)
173	        elif isinstance(items, list):
174	            for i, sub in enumerate(items):
175	                if isinstance(sub, dict):
176	                    walk(sub, path + "/" + str(i), seen)
177	        for i, sub in enumerate(eff.get("prefixItems", []) or []):
178	            if isinstance(sub, dict):
179	                walk(sub, path + "/" + str(i), seen)
180	        ap = eff.get("additionalProperties")
181	        if isinstance(ap, dict):
182	            walk(ap, path + "/*", seen)
183	        pp = eff.get("patternProperties")
184	        if isinstance(pp, dict):
185	            for name in sorted(pp.keys()):
186	                sub = pp[name]
187	                if isinstance(sub, dict):
188	                    walk(sub, path + "/" + ptr.escape(name), seen)
189	
190	    walk(document, "", frozenset())
191	    return fields

194	def summary(field_schema: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
195	    """字段定义摘要：确定性的、可 JSON 序列化的结构关键字快照。"""
196	    out: dict[str, Any] = {}
197	    for key in STRUCTURAL_KEYS:
198	        if key in field_schema:
199	            out[key] = _canonical(field_schema[key])
200	    return out

203	def _canonical(value: Any) -> Any:
204	    """把取值转为可比较、可 JSON 序列化的规范形式。"""
205	    return json.loads(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False))

212	
213	def _types(schema: dict) -> frozenset[str]:
214	    t = schema.get("type")
215	    if t is None:
216	        return frozenset()
217	    return frozenset(t if isinstance(t, list) else [t])
218	
219	
220	def _enum(schema: dict):
221	    if "enum" in schema:
222	        return tuple(json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) for v in schema["enum"])
223	    if "const" in schema:
224	        return (json.dumps(schema["const"], sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False),)
225	    return None
226	
227	
228	def _bounds(schema: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
229	    return {k: _canonical(schema[k]) for k in _BOUND_KEYS if k in schema}
230	
231	
232	def annotation_signature(schema: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
233	    return {k: schema[k] for k in ANNOTATION_KEYS if k in schema}
234	
235	
236	# 兼容内部旧命名。
237	_annotation_signature = annotation_signature
238	
239	
240	def structural_signature(schema: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
241	    """同路径字段的结构特征（排除注解、嵌套容器与 required）。
242	
243	    嵌套容器由各自展开出的子字段条目负责；required 变化由编排层按
244	    子字段生成 required_added/required_removed 条目。
245	    """
246	    return {
247	        k: _canonical(v)
248	        for k, v in schema.items()
249	        if k not in ANNOTATION_KEYS and k not in CONTAINER_KEYS and k != "required"
250	    }
251	
252	
253	def classify_pair(old: dict, new: dict) -> str:
254	    """比较同一路径字段的新旧 *结构* 定义，返回兼容结论。
255	
256	    仅当结构签名确实不同时调用（注解-only 变化由编排层判为 metadata）。
257	
258	    约定：
259	      * 放宽枚举、integer→number、增加默认值 → compatible；
260	      * 收窄类型/枚举、允许原本不接受的 null、新增约束 → breaking；
261	      * 同时有收有放按 breaking。
262	    """
263	    if structural_signature(old) == structural_signature(new):
264	        return "metadata"
265	
266	    verdicts: list[str] = []
267	
268	    # 1) 类型：integer -> number 放宽；出现新增的 null 为破坏性；其余集合变化收紧/扩展。
269	    ot, nt = _types(old), _types(new)
270	    if nt != ot:
271	        if ot == frozenset({"integer"}) and nt == frozenset({"number"}):
272	            verdicts.append("compatible")
273	        else:
274	            added = nt - ot
275	            if "null" in added:
276	                verdicts.append("breaking")
277	            elif ot and not nt:
278	                verdicts.append("compatible")  # 取消类型约束 = 放宽
279	            elif ot and nt and nt > ot:
280	                verdicts.append("compatible")  # 类型集合扩大
281	            elif not ot:
282	                # 旧未约束类型、新给出具体类型：视为收窄。
283	                verdicts.append("breaking")
284	            else:
285	                verdicts.append("breaking")
286	
287	    # 2) 枚举/const：取值集合扩大为放宽，缩小为收窄。
288	    oe, ne = _enum(old), _enum(new)
289	    if oe != ne:
290	        if oe is None and ne is None:
291	            pass
292	        elif oe is not None and ne is not None:
293	            oset, nset = frozenset(oe), frozenset(ne)
294	            verdicts.append("compatible" if oset < nset else "breaking")
295	        elif ne is None:
296	            verdicts.append("compatible")  # 取消枚举 = 放宽
297	        else:
298	            verdicts.append("breaking")  # 新增强枚举 = 收窄
299	
300	    # 3) 数值/长度等边界：逐项比较。
301	    ob, nb = _bounds(old), _bounds(new)
302	    if ob != nb:
303	        verdicts.extend(_classify_bounds(ob, nb))
304	
305	    # 4) default：增加默认值明确属于兼容；移除或改变默认值会让依赖缺省
306	    #    行为的数据发生变化，保守归为破坏性。
307	    if "default" in new and "default" not in old:
308	        verdicts.append("compatible")
309	    elif old.get("default") != new.get("default"):
310	        verdicts.append("breaking")
311	
312	    # 5) 其余结构键（未知/新增约束键）：出现即为新增约束 → breaking；
313	    #    消失为放宽 → compatible。
314	    known = set(STRUCTURAL_KEYS) | set(ANNOTATION_KEYS) | {"default"}
315	
316	    def is_extra(k: str) -> bool:
317	        return (
318	            k not in known
319	            and not k.startswith("$")
320	            and k not in CONTAINER_KEYS
321	        )
322	
323	    extra_o = {k for k in old if is_extra(k)}
324	    extra_n = {k for k in new if is_extra(k)}
325	    if extra_n - extra_o:
326	        verdicts.append("breaking")
327	    if extra_o - extra_n:
328	        verdicts.append("compatible")
329	
330	    if "breaking" in verdicts:
331	        return "breaking"
332	    if "compatible" in verdicts:
333	        return "compatible"
334	    return "metadata"
335	
336	
337	def _classify_bounds(ob: dict, nb: dict) -> list[str]:
338	    """对数值边界做放宽/收窄判定。
339	
340	    lower 类关键字（minimum 等）减小为放宽；upper 类增大为放宽；
341	    pattern/format/multipleOf/uniqueItems 出现或收紧为 breaking。
342	    """
343	    out: list[str] = []
344	    lower = ("minimum", "exclusiveMinimum", "minLength", "minItems", "minProperties")
345	    upper = ("maximum", "exclusiveMaximum", "maxLength", "maxItems", "maxProperties")
346	
347	    for key in sorted(set(ob) | set(nb)):
348	        ov, nv = ob.get(key), nb.get(key)
349	        if ov == nv:
350	            continue
351	        if nv is None:
352	            out.append("compatible")  # 移除边界 = 放宽
353	            continue
354	        if ov is None:
355	            out.append("breaking")  # 新增边界 = 收窄
356	            continue
357	        if key in lower:
358	            out.append("compatible" if nv < ov else "breaking")
359	        elif key in upper:
360	            out.append("compatible" if nv > ov else "breaking")
361	        else:
362	            # pattern / format / multipleOf / uniqueItems：改变既有约束 = 收窄。
363	            out.append("breaking")
364	    return out
365

1	"""字段级影响分析。
2	
3	直接影响：资产的字段引用与目标字段 ``(schema, version, path)`` 精确相等。
4	传递影响：从资产引用的具体字段出发，沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边正向解析，
5	若能到达目标字段（精确相等、或祖先/后代包含关系），即构成传递命中。
6	
7	正向解析从资产引用的 *具体* 路径出发，路径长度随跨边跳数只减不增，因此
8	即使 Schema 之间存在根级引用环，状态空间也是有限的。传递结果按稳定标识
9	``(资产, schema, version, 引用路径)`` 去重。
10	"""
11	
12	from __future__ import annotations
13	
14	from dataclasses import dataclass
15	
16	from . import limits, pointer as ptr
17	from .errors import ImpactAnalysisTooLarge
18	from .registry import Registry, RefEdge
19	
20	
21	@dataclass(frozen=True)
22	class Reach:
23	    schema: str
24	    version: str
25	    path: str
26	
27	
28	def _related(a: str, b: str) -> bool:
29	    return a == b or ptr.is_under(a, b) or ptr.is_under(b, a)
30	
31	
32	def _build_outgoing(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]]:
33	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]] = {}
34	    for edge in registry.all_edges():
35	        outgoing.setdefault((edge.src_schema, edge.src_version), []).append(edge)
36	    for edges in outgoing.values():
37	        edges.sort(
38	            key=lambda e: (e.dst_schema, e.dst_version, e.src_path, e.dst_path)
39	        )
40	    return outgoing
41	
42	
43	def forward_reach(
44	    registry: Registry,
45	    schema: str,
46	    version: str,
47	    path: str,
48	    outgoing: dict[tuple[str, str], list[RefEdge]] | None = None,
49	    cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[Reach]] | None = None,
50	) -> list[Reach]:
51	    """从一个具体字段出发正向解析跨 Schema 引用，返回可到达的全部字段。
52	
53	    每条出边满足：边的源路径与当前路径相等，或是当前路径的祖先
54	    （引用了包含当前字段的子树）；目标侧路径按后缀对齐。
55	    """
56	    if cache is not None:
57	        cached = cache.get((schema, version, path))
58	        if cached is not None:
59	            return cached
60	    if outgoing is None:
61	        outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
62	
63	    start = Reach(schema, version, path)
64	    reached: dict[Reach, None] = {start: None}
65	    queue: list[tuple[Reach, int]] = [(start, 0)]
66	    edges_walked = 0
67	
68	    while queue:
69	        state, depth = queue.pop(0)
70	        if depth >= limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH:
71	            raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
72	                "影响链深度超过公开限制",
73	                details={
74	                    "reason": "depth_exceeded",
75	                    "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_DEPTH,
76	                    "schema": state.schema,
77	                    "version": state.version,
78	                    "path": state.path,
79	                },
80	            )
81	        for edge in outgoing.get((state.schema, state.version), ()):
82	            sp, cp = ptr.parse(edge.src_path), ptr.parse(state.path)
83	            if not (len(sp) <= len(cp) and cp[: len(sp)] == sp):
84	                continue
85	            edges_walked += 1
86	            if edges_walked > limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED:
87	                raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
88	                    "影响链引用边数量超过公开限制",
89	                    details={"reason": "edges_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_VISITED},
90	                )
91	            suffix = cp[len(sp) :]
92	            mapped = Reach(
93	                edge.dst_schema,
94	                edge.dst_version,
95	                ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix)),
96	            )
97	            if mapped in reached:
98	                continue
99	            reached[mapped] = None
100	            queue.append((mapped, depth + 1))
101	
102	    del reached[start]
103	    result = sorted(reached.keys(), key=lambda r: (r.schema, r.version, r.path))
104	    if cache is not None:
105	        cache[(schema, version, path)] = result
106	    return result
107	
108	
109	def analyze_field(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> dict:
110	    """返回单个字段的影响资产：直接 + 传递（各自稳定排序、去重）。"""
111	    registry.get_schema(schema, version)
112	
113	    direct: dict[str, dict] = {}
114	    transitive_map: dict[tuple[str, str, str, str], dict] = {}
115	    outgoing = _build_outgoing(registry)
116	    reach_cache: dict[tuple[str, str, str], list[Reach]] = {}
117	
118	    for asset in registry.all_assets():
119	        for ref in asset.refs:
120	            if ref.schema == schema and ref.version == version:
121	                if ref.path == path:
122	                    direct.setdefault(
123	                        asset.id,
124	                        {"asset_id": asset.id, "name": asset.name, "kind": asset.kind},
125	                    )
126	                    continue
127	
128	            # 传递：从资产引用的具体字段正向解析到目标字段。
129	            reachable = forward_reach(
130	                registry, ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path, outgoing, reach_cache
131	            )
132	            matched = [r for r in reachable if r.schema == schema and r.version == version
133	                       and _related(r.path, path)]
134	            if not matched:
135	                continue
136	            key = (asset.id, ref.schema, ref.version, ref.path)
137	            entry = transitive_map.get(key)
138	            if entry is None:
139	                entry = {
140	                    "asset_id": asset.id,
141	                    "name": asset.name,
142	                    "kind": asset.kind,
143	                    "schema": ref.schema,
144	                    "version": ref.version,
145	                    "path": ref.path,
146	                    "matched_paths": [],
147	                }
148	                transitive_map[key] = entry
149	            for r in matched:
150	                if r.path not in entry["matched_paths"]:
151	                    entry["matched_paths"].append(r.path)
152	
153	    transitive = list(transitive_map.values())
154	    for entry in transitive:
155	        entry["matched_paths"].sort(key=lambda p: (ptr.parse(p), p))
156	
157	    if len(direct) + len(transitive) > limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS:
158	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
159	            "影响资产数量超过公开限制",
160	            details={"reason": "assets_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS},
161	        )
162	
163	    return {
164	        "schema": schema,
165	        "version": version,
166	        "path": path,
167	        "direct_assets": [direct[k] for k in sorted(direct)],
168	        "transitive_assets": sorted(
169	            transitive,
170	            key=lambda a: (a["asset_id"], a["schema"], a["version"], a["path"]),
171	        ),
172	    }

这些限制是公开行为契约的一部分：触发上限时统一抛出

MAX_IMPACT_ASSETS = 10_000

1	"""JSON Schema 合法性校验（结构级）。
2	
3	这里只判定文档是不是 *合法的 JSON Schema*（关键字取值结构合法、内部
4	``$ref`` 可解析、无递归病态结构），不做实例数据校验。未知关键字一律允许，
5	与 JSON Schema 的扩展惯例一致。
6	"""
7	
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import re
11	from typing import Any
12	
13	from .errors import SchemaComparisonInvalid
14	
15	_ALLOWED_TYPES = {
16	    "null",
17	    "boolean",
18	    "object",
19	    "array",
20	    "number",
21	    "string",
22	    "integer",
23	}
24	
25	_NONNEG_INT_KEYWORDS = (
26	    "minLength",
27	    "maxLength",
28	    "minItems",
29	    "maxItems",
30	    "minProperties",
31	    "maxProperties",
32	)
33	_NUMBER_KEYWORDS = (
34	    "minimum",
35	    "maximum",
36	    "exclusiveMinimum",
37	    "exclusiveMaximum",
38	    "multipleOf",
39	)
40	_STRING_KEYWORDS = ("title", "description", "$comment", "format")
41	
42	
43	def _is_bool(x: Any) -> bool:
44	    return isinstance(x, bool)
45	
46	
47	def _is_schema(x: Any) -> bool:
48	    return isinstance(x, dict) or _is_bool(x)
49	
50	
51	def validate_schema(document: Any) -> None:
52	    """校验整份文档；不合法时抛出 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。"""
53	    if not isinstance(document, (dict, bool)):
54	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
55	            "候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：根节点必须是对象或布尔值",
56	            details={"reason": "root_not_schema"},
57	        )
58	    try:
59	        _walk(document, (), set(), document)
60	    except _RecursiveRef as exc:
61	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
62	            "候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：$ref 形成无展开的递归环",
63	            details={"reason": "recursive_ref", "ref": str(exc)},
64	        )
65	
66	
67	class _RecursiveRef(Exception):
68	    pass
69	
70	
71	def _ref_target(doc: Any, ref: str) -> Any | None:
72	    """解析文档内 ``#/...`` 引用；非文档内引用或解析失败返回 None。"""
73	    if not ref.startswith("#"):
74	        return None
75	    frag = ref[1:]
76	    if frag == "" or frag == "/":
77	        return doc
78	    if not frag.startswith("/"):
79	        return None
80	    cur: Any = doc
81	    for raw in frag[1:].split("/"):
82	        tok = raw.replace("~1", "/").replace("~0", "~")
83	        if isinstance(cur, dict):
84	            if tok not in cur:
85	                return None
86	            cur = cur[tok]
87	        elif isinstance(cur, list):
88	            try:
89	                cur = cur[int(tok)]
90	            except (ValueError, IndexError):
91	                return None
92	        else:
93	            return None
94	    return cur
95	
96	
97	def _walk(node: Any, path: tuple[str, ...], active: set, root: Any) -> None:
98	    if _is_bool(node):
99	        return
100	    if not isinstance(node, dict):
101	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
102	            f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{path} 处不是对象或布尔值",
103	            details={"reason": "node_not_schema", "path": "/" + "/".join(path)},
104	        )
105	
106	    # $ref：文档内引用必须可解析且在当前展开栈上不成环。
107	    ref = node.get("$ref")
108	    if ref is not None:
109	        if not isinstance(ref, str) or not ref:
110	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
111	                "候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：$ref 必须是非空字符串",
112	                details={"reason": "bad_ref", "path": "/" + "/".join(path)},
113	            )
114	        if ref.startswith("#"):
115	            target = _ref_target(root, ref)
116	            if target is None:
117	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
118	                    f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：内部引用 {ref} 无法解析",
119	                    details={"reason": "unresolvable_ref", "ref": ref},
120	                )
121	            key = id(target)
122	            if key in active:
123	                raise _RecursiveRef(ref)
124	            active = active | {key}
125	            _walk(target, path, active, root)
126	            active.discard(key)
127	
128	    _check_keywords(node, path)
129	
130	    for name, sub in node.get("properties", {}).items():
131	        _walk(sub, path + ("properties", name), active, root)
132	    for name, sub in node.get("patternProperties", {}).items():
133	        try:
134	            re.compile(name)
135	        except re.error as exc:
136	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
137	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：patternProperties 的正则 {name!r} 非法",
138	                details={"reason": "bad_pattern", "pattern": name},
139	            ) from exc
140	        _walk(sub, path + ("patternProperties", name), active, root)
141	    if "additionalProperties" in node and node["additionalProperties"] is not True:
142	        ap = node["additionalProperties"]
143	        if _is_schema(ap) and ap is not True:
144	            _walk(ap, path + ("additionalProperties",), active, root)
145	        elif ap not in (True, False):
146	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
147	                "候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：additionalProperties 必须是 Schema 或布尔值",
148	                details={"reason": "bad_additional_properties"},
149	            )
150	    if "items" in node:
151	        items = node["items"]
152	        if _is_schema(items):
153	            _walk(items, path + ("items",), active, root)
154	        elif isinstance(items, list):  # 兼容 draft-4 元组形式
155	            for i, sub in enumerate(items):
156	                _walk(sub, path + ("items", str(i)), active, root)
157	        else:
158	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
159	                "候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：items 必须是 Schema",
160	                details={"reason": "bad_items"},
161	            )
162	    for kw in ("contains", "not", "propertyNames", "unevaluatedProperties"):
163	        if kw in node and _is_schema(node[kw]):
164	            _walk(node[kw], path + (kw,), active, root)
165	    for kw in ("prefixItems",):
166	        if kw in node:
167	            vals = node[kw]
168	            if not isinstance(vals, list) or not all(_is_schema(x) for x in vals):
169	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
170	                    f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{kw} 必须是 Schema 列表",
171	                    details={"reason": f"bad_{kw}"},
172	                )
173	            for i, sub in enumerate(vals):
174	                _walk(sub, path + (kw, str(i)), active, root)
175	    for kw in ("allOf", "anyOf", "oneOf"):
176	        if kw in node:
177	            vals = node[kw]
178	            if not isinstance(vals, list) or not vals or not all(_is_schema(x) for x in vals):
179	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
180	                    f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{kw} 必须是非空 Schema 列表",
181	                    details={"reason": f"bad_{kw}"},
182	                )
183	            for i, sub in enumerate(vals):
184	                _walk(sub, path + (kw, str(i)), active, root)
185	    for kw in ("definitions", "$defs"):
186	        if kw in node:
187	            defs = node[kw]
188	            if not isinstance(defs, dict):
189	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
190	                    f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{kw} 必须是对象",
191	                    details={"reason": f"bad_{kw}"},
192	                )
193	            for name, sub in defs.items():
194	                _walk(sub, path + (kw, name), active, root)
195	
196	
197	def _check_keywords(node: dict, path: tuple[str, ...]) -> None:
198	    where = "/" + "/".join(path)
199	
200	    t = node.get("type")
201	    if t is not None:
202	        types = t if isinstance(t, list) else [t]
203	        if not types or not all(isinstance(x, str) and x in _ALLOWED_TYPES for x in types):
204	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
205	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 type 非法",
206	                details={"reason": "bad_type", "path": where},
207	            )
208	        if len(set(types)) != len(types):
209	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
210	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 type 存在重复",
211	                details={"reason": "dup_type", "path": where},
212	            )
213	
214	    if "enum" in node and not isinstance(node["enum"], list):
215	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
216	            f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 enum 必须是数组",
217	            details={"reason": "bad_enum", "path": where},
218	        )
219	
220	    req = node.get("required")
221	    if req is not None:
222	        if not isinstance(req, list) or not all(isinstance(x, str) for x in req) or not req:
223	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
224	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 required 必须是非空字符串数组",
225	                details={"reason": "bad_required", "path": where},
226	            )
227	        if len(set(req)) != len(req):
228	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
229	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 required 存在重复项",
230	                details={"reason": "dup_required", "path": where},
231	            )
232	
233	    props = node.get("properties")
234	    if props is not None and not isinstance(props, dict):
235	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
236	            f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 properties 必须是对象",
237	            details={"reason": "bad_properties", "path": where},
238	        )
239	
240	    for kw in _STRING_KEYWORDS:
241	        if kw in node and not isinstance(node[kw], str):
242	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
243	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 {kw} 必须是字符串",
244	                details={"reason": f"bad_{kw}", "path": where},
245	            )
246	    for kw in _NONNEG_INT_KEYWORDS:
247	        if kw in node:
248	            v = node[kw]
249	            if _is_bool(v) or not isinstance(v, int) or v < 0:
250	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
251	                    f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 {kw} 必须是非负整数",
252	                    details={"reason": f"bad_{kw}", "path": where},
253	                )
254	    for kw in _NUMBER_KEYWORDS:
255	        if kw in node and (_is_bool(node[kw]) or not isinstance(node[kw], (int, float))):
256	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
257	                f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 {kw} 必须是数值",
258	                details={"reason": f"bad_{kw}", "path": where},
259	            )
260	    if "uniqueItems" in node and not _is_bool(node["uniqueItems"]):
261	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
262	            f"候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema：{where} 的 uniqueItems 必须是布尔值",
263	            details={"reason": "bad_unique_items", "path": where},
264	        )

1	# Meta Catalog
2	
3	元数据目录与检索服务：Schema 注册、影响分析、全文检索，以及字段级破坏性变更
4	识别与变更追溯检索。纯 Python 标准库实现，不依赖外部同类组件。
5	
6	## 能力概览
7	
8	1. **Schema 注册**：按 `名称@版本` 注册不可变 JSON Schema；支持跨 Schema
9	   `$ref`（形如 `Address@1.0#/properties/street`），允许前向引用与引用环，
10	   目标 Schema 已注册但引用字段不存在时注册即报错。
11	2. **目录资产**：注册直接引用某些 Schema 字段的资产（服务、任务、报表等）。
12	3. **影响分析**：给定字段，返回直接引用它的资产，以及经其他 Schema
13	   `$ref` 传递引用它的资产；传递影响按稳定路径去重。
14	4. **字段级变更识别**：比较同一 Schema 的基线版本与候选文档（可附显式字段
15	   重命名映射），生成可直接展示、可检索的字段级变更报告，报告关联原 Schema
16	   标识与版本。
17	5. **升级影响汇总**：在字段级变更报告之上按资产汇总升级影响
18	   （`analyze_upgrade_impact`），标注每个资产受影响的变更与命中方式
19	   （直接 / 传递 / 两者），只读执行，不生成报告、不入索引。
20	6. **全文检索**：Schema、资产与报告中的每条字段变更统一入索引，支持关键词
21	   与结构化条件组合检索。
22	
23	## 快速开始
24	
25	```python
26	from meta_catalog import MetaCatalog
27	from meta_catalog.errors import SchemaComparisonInvalid, ImpactAnalysisTooLarge
28	
29	catalog = MetaCatalog()
30	
31	catalog.register_schema("Person", "1.0", {
32	    "type": "object",
33	    "properties": {
34	        "name":  {"type": "string"},
35	        "age":   {"type": "integer"},
36	        "level": {"type": "string", "enum": ["a", "b"]},
37	    },
38	    "required": ["name"],
39	})
40	
41	catalog.register_asset("svc-order", "订单服务", "service", refs=[
42	    {"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/name"},
43	])
44	
45	report = catalog.compare_schemas(
46	    "Person", "1.0",
47	    {
48	        "type": "object",
49	        "properties": {
50	            "name":  {"type": "string"},
51	            "years": {"type": "integer"},          # age 改名为 years
52	            "level": {"type": "string", "enum": ["a", "b", "c"]},  # 放宽枚举
53	            "nick":  {"type": "string"},           # 新增非必填
54	        },
55	        "required": ["name"],
56	    },
57	    candidate_version="2.0",
58	    renames=[{"from": "/age", "to": "/years"}],
59	)
60	
61	# 读取 / 追溯检索
62	catalog.get_report(report["report_id"])
63	catalog.search(schema="Person", version="2.0", compatibility="breaking")
64	catalog.search(change_kind="rename", asset_name="订单")
65	```
66	
67	## 字段路径
68	
69	字段路径采用逻辑化 JSON Pointer：
70	
71	- 对象属性省略 `properties` 段：`/properties/name` 写作 `/name`；
72	- 数组元素写作 `-`：`/properties/tags/items` 写作 `/tags/-`；
73	- `additionalProperties` 写作 `*`；
74	- 根对象为空串 `""`。
75	
76	资产注册时既接受文档指针也接受逻辑路径，注册时统一结合文档结构解析。
77	
78	## 变更种类与兼容结论
79	
80	每条结果包含：字段路径、`old_path`/`new_path`、旧定义摘要、新定义摘要、
81	变更种类、兼容结论、直接影响资产、传递影响资产。
82	
83	| 变更种类 `change_kind` | 含义 | 兼容结论 |
84	|---|---|---|
85	| `added` | 新增属性 | 非必填 `compatible`；必填 `breaking` |
86	| `deleted` | 删除属性 | `breaking` |
87	| `modified` | 结构定义变化 | 按下表判定 |
88	| `required_added` | 既有字段新增必填约束 | `breaking` |
89	| `required_removed` | 既有字段解除必填约束 | `compatible` |
90	| `rename` | 显式声明的字段重命名（整棵子树按一次计入） | `breaking` |
91	| `metadata` | 仅 `title`/`description`/`$comment` 变化 | `metadata` |
92	
93	`modified` 的兼容规则：
94	
95	- **兼容**：放宽枚举、`integer` 扩展为 `number`、增加默认值、取消/放宽数值与
96	  长度边界、扩大类型集合；
97	- **破坏**：收窄类型或枚举、新增枚举约束、新增边界约束、允许原本不接受的
98	  `null`、移除或改变默认值；
99	- 同时存在放宽与收窄时，按 **breaking** 处理。
100	
101	显式重命名映射按一次 `rename` 计入结果，不再同时计为删除和新增；映射子树中
102	未被覆盖的删除与新增仍分别呈现。结构变化与新增必填同时发生时，种类记为
103	`modified`，兼容结论取更严格的 `breaking`。
104	
105	## 重命名映射规则
106	
107	`renames=[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]`，以下情形统一返回错误码
108	`SchemaComparisonInvalid`：
109	
110	- 候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema；
111	- 指定的基线/候选版本不存在；
112	- 重命名起点在基线版本不存在，或终点在候选版本不存在；
113	- 同一路径（含端点）被重复映射，或映射端点的子树相互重叠；
114	- 起点仍存在于候选版本、或终点已存在于基线版本（跨版本不一致）。
115	
116	## 影响分析
117	
118	- **直接影响**：资产引用与目标字段 `(Schema, 版本, 路径)` 精确相等。
119	- **传递影响**：沿跨 Schema `$ref` 边反向传播，按字段后缀对齐；引用整个
120	  对象或更深子路径的资产同样命中。结果按
121	  `(资产标识, Schema, 版本, 稳定路径)` 去重并稳定排序。
122	- 影响链深度、遍历边数、影响资产数量、单次比较的分析对象字段数与变更条目数
123	  超过公开限制（见 `meta_catalog/limits.py`）时统一返回
124	  `ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
125	
126	## 升级影响汇总
127	
128	`catalog.analyze_upgrade_impact(name, baseline_version, candidate, *, candidate_version=None, renames=None, asset_ids=None)`
129	在字段级变更比较之上给出按资产维度的升级影响汇总。候选文档、候选版本、
130	重命名映射与字段路径语义与 `compare_schemas` 完全一致；返回的 `report_id`
131	与相同输入调用 `compare_schemas` 得到的 `report_id` 相同。
132	
133	- `asset_ids=None` 覆盖全部资产；指定列表时去重、与传入顺序无关，只覆盖
134	  所列资产；未知资产返回 `NotFound`。空列表表示不覆盖任何资产。
135	- 候选文档非法、候选/基线版本不存在、重命名映射不合法时返回
136	  `SchemaComparisonInvalid`；超过既有公开限制时返回 `ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
137	- 该调用为只读：不注册候选文档、不生成或改动变更报告、不写入检索索引。
138	
139	返回结构（普通 dict/list，可直接 JSON 序列化）：
140	
141	```python
142	{
143	    "report_id": "...",
144	    "schema": "Person",
145	    "baseline_version": "1.0",
146	    "candidate_version": "2.0",
147	    "summary": {
148	        "asset_total": 3,        # 入选资产总数
149	        "breaking_assets": 1,    # 最严重命中为 breaking 的资产数
150	        "compatible_assets": 1,  # 最严重命中为 compatible 的资产数
151	        "metadata_assets": 0,    # 最严重命中为 metadata 的资产数
152	        "unaffected_assets": 1,  # 无任何命中的资产数
153	        "changed_paths": 2,      # 入选资产命中项的 path 去重数
154	    },
155	    "assets": [
156	        {
157	            "asset_id": "svc-order",
158	            "name": "订单服务",
159	            "kind": "service",
160	            "status": "breaking",   # breaking > compatible > metadata > unaffected
161	            "changes": [
162	                # 保留变更报告的全部字段与既有稳定排序，新增 impact_kind
163	                {"path": "/age", "change_kind": "deleted",
164	                 "compatibility": "breaking", "impact_kind": "direct", ...},
165	            ],
166	        },
167	        # 无命中的资产同样列出：status=unaffected，changes=[]
168	    ],
169	}
170	```
171	
172	- `assets` 按 `asset_id` 升序，未受影响资产也包含在内；
173	- 每条变更的 `impact_kind` 为 `direct`（直接命中）、`transitive`（传递命中）
174	  或 `both`（同一变更直接与传递同时命中）；同一资产与同一变更只保留一条，
175	  去重口径与字段级影响分析一致；
176	- 相同输入始终返回相同的字段顺序、计数、排序与结论。
177	
178	## 检索
179	
180	`catalog.search(keyword, **filters)`，条件之间为 AND：
181	
182	- `keyword`：普通关键词，按固定分词口径（拉丁连续串、中文二元组、小写化、
183	  AND 全命中）匹配可检索文本字段；
184	- 结构化过滤：`schema`、`version`、`field_path`、`change_kind`、
185	  `compatibility`、`asset_name`（命中直接或传递影响资产名称）、`doc_type`、
186	  `limit`；
187	- 返回条目标注 `matched_fields`（命中字段）与命中资产摘要；
188	- 排序为「命中字段数降序 + 确定性键升序」，与索引插入顺序无关。报告进入
189	  索引不改变旧关键词查询的匹配口径与排序稳定性。
190	
191	## 不可变性与边界
192	
193	- Schema 版本、版本关系与资产依赖关系注册后不可变；重复注册返回
194	  `AlreadyExists`；所有读取返回深拷贝。
195	- 内联候选文档不会被注册；比较、报告读取与检索都不会改写既有注册内容。
196	- 报告只通过公开接口返回，不规定落盘格式；相同输入产生相同 `report_id`、
197	  相同字段顺序、影响顺序与兼容结论。
198	- 错误码：`NotFound`、`AlreadyExists`、`SchemaComparisonInvalid`、
199	  `ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
200	
201	## 测试
202	
203	```bash
204	python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
205	```

  `null`、移除或改变默认值；

`modified`，兼容结论取更严格的 `breaking`。

## 重命名映射规则

`renames=[{"from": 旧路径, "to": 新路径}, ...]`，以下情形统一返回错误码
`SchemaComparisonInvalid`：

- 候选文档不是合法 JSON Schema；
- 指定的基线/候选版本不存在；
- 重命名起点在基线版本不存在，或终点在候选版本不存在；
- 同一路径（含端点）被重复映射，或映射端点的子树相互重叠；
- 起点仍存在于候选版本、或终点已存在于基线版本（跨版本不一致）。

## 影响分析

- **直接影响**：资产引用与目标字段 `(Schema, 版本, 路径)` 精确相等。
- **传递影响**：沿跨 Schema `$ref` 边反向传播，按字段后缀对齐；引用整个
  对象或更深子路径的资产同样命中。结果按
  `(资产标识, Schema, 版本, 稳定路径)` 去重并稳定排序。
- 影响链深度、遍历边数、影响资产数量、单次比较的分析对象字段数与变更条目数
  超过公开限制（见 `meta_catalog/limits.py`）时统一返回
  `ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。

## 升级影响汇总

`catalog.analyze_upgrade_impact(name, baseline_version, candidate, *, candidate_version=None, renames=None, asset_ids=None)`
在字段级变更比较之上给出按资产维度的升级影响汇总。候选文档、候选版本、
重命名映射与字段路径语义与 `compare_schemas` 完全一致；返回的 `report_id`
与相同输入调用 `compare_schemas` 得到的 `report_id` 相同。

- `asset_ids=None` 覆盖全部资产；指定列表时去重、与传入顺序无关，只覆盖
  所列资产；未知资产返回 `NotFound`。空列表表示不覆盖任何资产。
- 候选文档非法、候选/基线版本不存在、重命名映射不合法时返回
  `SchemaComparisonInvalid`；超过既有公开限制时返回 `ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。
- 该调用为只读：不注册候选文档、不生成或改动变更报告、不写入检索索引。

返回结构（普通 dict/list，可直接 JSON 序列化）：

```python
{
    "report_id": "...",
    "schema": "Person",
    "baseline_version": "1.0",
    "candidate_version": "2.0",
    "summary": {
        "asset_total": 3,        # 入选资产总数
        "breaking_assets": 1,    # 最严重命中为 breaking 的资产数
        "compatible_assets": 1,  # 最严重命中为 compatible 的资产数
        "metadata_assets": 0,    # 最严重命中为 metadata 的资产数
        "unaffected_assets": 1,  # 无任何命中的资产数
        "changed_paths": 2,      # 入选资产命中项的 path 去重数
    },
    "assets": [
        {
            "asset_id": "svc-order",
            "name": "订单服务",
            "kind": "service",
            "status": "breaking",   # breaking > compatible > metadata > unaffected
            "changes": [
                # 保留变更报告的全部字段与既有稳定排序，新增 impact_kind
                {"path": "/age", "change_kind": "deleted",
                 "compatibility": "breaking", "impact_kind": "direct", ...},
            ],
        },
        # 无命中的资产同样列出：status=unaffected，changes=[]
    ],
}
```

- `assets` 按 `asset_id` 升序，未受影响资产也包含在内；
- 每条变更的 `impact_kind` 为 `direct`（直接命中）、`transitive`（传递命中）
  或 `both`（同一变更直接与传递同时命中）；同一资产与同一变更只保留一条，
  去重口径与字段级影响分析一致；
- 相同输入始终返回相同的字段顺序、计数、排序与结论。

## 检索

`catalog.search(keyword, **filters)`，条件之间为 AND：

- `keyword`：普通关键词，按固定分词口径（拉丁连续串、中文二元组、小写化、
  AND 全命中）匹配可检索文本字段；
- 结构化过滤：`schema`、`version`、`field_path`、`change_kind`、
  `compatibility`、`asset_name`（命中直接或传递影响资产名称）、`doc_type`、
  `limit`；
- 返回条目标注 `matched_fields`（命中字段）与命中资产摘要；
- 排序为「命中字段数降序 + 确定性键升序」，与索引插入顺序无关。报告进入
  索引不改变旧关键词查询的匹配口径与排序稳定性。

## 不可变性与边界

- Schema 版本、版本关系与资产依赖关系注册后不可变；重复注册返回
  `AlreadyExists`；所有读取返回深拷贝。
- 内联候选文档不会被注册；比较、报告读取与检索都不会改写既有注册内容。
- 报告只通过公开接口返回，不规定落盘格式；相同输入产生相同 `report_id`、
  相同字段顺序、影响顺序与兼容结论。
- 错误码：`NotFound`、`AlreadyExists`、`SchemaComparisonInvalid`、
  `ImpactAnalysisTooLarge`。

## 测试

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
```

        )

            [{"schema": "Address", "version": "1.0", "path": "/street"}],
        )
        self.c.register_asset(

            [{"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/address/street"}],
        )
        self.c.register_asset(

import copy
import unittest

from meta_catalog import MetaCatalog
from meta_catalog.errors import AlreadyExistsError


def build_catalog():
    c = MetaCatalog()
    v1 = {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Person schema",
        "properties": {
            "name": {"type": "string", "title": "姓名"},
            "age": {"type": "integer"},
            "level": {"type": "string", "enum": ["a", "b"]},
        },
        "required": ["name"],
    }
    c.register_schema("Person", "1.0", v1)
    c.register_asset(
        "svc-mail", "邮寄服务", "service",
        [{"schema": "Person", "version": "1.0", "path": "/name"}],
    )
    v2 = {
        "type": "object",
        "title": "Person schema",
        "properties": {
            "name": {"type": "string", "title": "姓名", "description": "全名"},
            "age": {"type": "number"},
            "level": {"type": "string", "enum": ["a"]},
            "nick": {"type": "string"},
        },
        "required": ["name", "age"],
    }
    c.compare_schemas("Person", "1.0", v2, candidate_version="2.0")
    return c, v1


class SearchTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.c, self.v1 = build_catalog()

    def test_keyword_search_returns_schema_asset_change(self):
        hits = self.c.search("name")
        types = {h["type"] for h in hits}
        self.assertIn("schema", types)
        self.assertIn("asset", types)
        self.assertIn("change", types)

    def test_filter_by_change_kind_and_compatibility(self):
        hits = self.c.search(change_kind="modified", compatibility="breaking")
        self.assertTrue(hits)
        paths = {h["path"] for h in hits}
        # level 枚举收窄、age 新增必填，两者均为 breaking
        self.assertEqual(paths, {"/age", "/level"})
        for h in hits:
            self.assertEqual(h["change_kind"], "modified")
            self.assertEqual(h["compatibility"], "breaking")

    def test_filter_by_field_path(self):
        hits = self.c.search(field_path="/age")
        self.assertTrue(hits)
        for h in hits:
            self.assertTrue(
                h["path"] == "/age"
                or h.get("old_path") == "/age"
                or h.get("new_path") == "/age"
            )

    def test_filter_by_schema_and_version(self):
        hits = self.c.search(schema="Person", version="2.0")
        self.assertTrue(hits)
        for h in hits:
            self.assertEqual(h.get("schema", h.get("name")), "Person")

    def test_filter_by_asset_name_matches_impacted_changes(self):
        hits = self.c.search(asset_name="邮寄")
        self.assertTrue(hits)
        # /name 变更为 metadata，且直接影响邮寄服务 -> change 必须命中
        change_hits = [h for h in hits if h["type"] == "change" and h["path"] == "/name"]
        self.assertTrue(change_hits)
        self.assertIn("impact_assets", change_hits[0]["matched_fields"])

    def test_combined_filters(self):
        hits = self.c.search(
            "age", schema="Person", version="2.0",
            change_kind="modified",
        )
        self.assertEqual(len(hits), 1)
        self.assertEqual(hits[0]["path"], "/age")

    def test_result_stability(self):
        a = self.c.search()
        b = self.c.search()
        keys = [(h["type"], h.get("path") or h.get("id") or h.get("name")) for h in a]
        keys2 = [(h["type"], h.get("path") or h.get("id") or h.get("name")) for h in b]
        self.assertEqual(keys, keys2)

    def test_old_keyword_matching_unchanged_after_report(self):
        c = MetaCatalog()
        c.register_schema("Widget", "1.0", {"type": "object", "title": "alpha beta"})
        before = [(h["type"], h["name"]) for h in c.search("alpha")]
        self.assertEqual(before, [("schema", "Widget")])
        # 生成报告后，旧查询结果语义不变。
        c.compare_schemas(
            "Widget", "1.0",
            {"type": "object", "title": "alpha beta", "properties": {"x": {"type": "string"}}},
        )
        after = [(h["type"], h.get("name") or h.get("path")) for h in c.search("alpha")]
        self.assertIn(("schema", "Widget"), after)
        # schema 命中字段不变
        schema_hit = next(h for h in c.search("alpha") if h["type"] == "schema")
        self.assertEqual(schema_hit["matched_fields"], ["title"])


class ImmutabilityTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_registration_never_overwritten(self):
        c, v1 = build_catalog()
        with self.assertRaises(AlreadyExistsError):
            c.register_schema("Person", "1.0", {"type": "string"})

    def test_returned_documents_are_copies(self):
        c, v1 = build_catalog()
        got = c.get_schema("Person", "1.0")
        got["document"]["properties"]["hacked"] = {"type": "string"}
        again = c.get_schema("Person", "1.0")
        self.assertNotIn("hacked", again["document"]["properties"])

    def test_compare_and_search_do_not_mutate_registry(self):
        c, v1 = build_catalog()
        before = c.get_schema("Person", "1.0")
        c.compare_schemas(
            "Person", "1.0",
            {"type": "object", "properties": {"ghost": {"type": "string"}}},
        )
        c.search("ghost")
        after = c.get_schema("Person", "1.0")
        self.assertEqual(before["document"], after["document"])
        # 候选文档未注册：版本列表不变
        self.assertEqual(c.list_versions("Person"), ["1.0"])

    def test_input_document_not_retained_by_reference(self):
        c = MetaCatalog()
        doc = {"type": "object", "properties": {"a": {"type": "string"}}}
        c.register_schema("S", "1.0", doc)
        doc["properties"]["a"]["type"] = "integer"
        self.assertEqual(
            c.get_schema("S", "1.0")["document"]["properties"]["a"]["type"], "string"
        )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

2	
3	输入两个同一 Schema 标识下的 JSON Schema 文档（基线版本、候选版本）与显式
4	字段重命名映射，产出确定性的字段级变更报告。
5	
6	变更种类（``change_kind``）：
7	  * ``added``            新增字段（非必填兼容 / 必填破坏）
8	  * ``deleted``          删除字段（破坏）
9	  * ``modified``         结构定义变化（按收窄/放宽判定）
10	  * ``required_added``   既有字段新增必填约束（破坏）
11	  * ``required_removed`` 既有字段解除必填约束（兼容）
12	  * ``rename``           显式声明的重命名（整棵子树按一次 rename 计入）
13	  * ``metadata``         仅标题/描述/注释变化（元数据变更）
14	
15	兼容结论（``compatibility``）：``breaking`` / ``compatible`` / ``metadata``。
16	"""

21	import json
22	from typing import Any

33	REQUIRED_REMOVED = "required_removed"

41	def _required_set(fields: dict[str, sf.Field]) -> set[str]:
42	    """收集文档内全部被标记为必填的字段路径（已合并 allOf 的 required）。"""
43	    out: set[str] = set()
44	    for f in fields.values():
45	        out.update(f.required_paths)
46	    return out
47	
48	
49	def _summary(schema: dict) -> dict[str, Any]:
50	    # required 是父节点对子字段的约束，不放进字段自身摘要。
51	    return {k: v for k, v in sf.summary(schema).items() if k != "required"}
52	
53	
54	def validate_renames(
55	    renames: list | None,
56	    old_fields: dict[str, sf.Field],
57	    new_fields: dict[str, sf.Field],
58	) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
59	    """校验并规范化重命名映射，失败时抛 :class:`SchemaComparisonInvalid`。"""
60	    from .errors import SchemaComparisonInvalid
61	
62	    if renames is None:
63	        return []
64	    if not isinstance(renames, list):
65	        raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
66	            "重命名映射必须是 [{from, to}, ...] 列表",
67	            details={"reason": "renames_not_list"},
68	        )
69	
70	    pairs: list[tuple[str, str]] = []
71	    for i, item in enumerate(renames):
72	        if isinstance(item, dict):
73	            src, dst = item.get("from"), item.get("to")
74	        elif isinstance(item, (tuple, list)) and len(item) == 2:
75	            src, dst = item[0], item[1]
76	        else:
77	            src = dst = None
78	        if not isinstance(src, str) or not isinstance(dst, str) or not src or not dst:
79	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
80	                f"第 {i} 条重命名映射必须包含非空字符串 from 与 to",
81	                details={"reason": "rename_invalid", "index": i},
82	            )
83	        pairs.append((src, dst))
84	
85	    # 1) 起点/终点必须存在于对应版本。
86	    for src, dst in pairs:
87	        if src not in old_fields:
88	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
89	                f"重命名起点 {src} 在基线版本中不存在",
90	                details={"reason": "rename_from_not_found", "path": src},
91	            )
92	        if dst not in new_fields:
93	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
94	                f"重命名终点 {dst} 在候选版本中不存在",
95	                details={"reason": "rename_to_not_found", "path": dst},
96	            )
97	
98	    # 2) 同一路径不得被重复映射（任一端点出现两次，或起点等于终点）。
99	    seen: set[str] = set()
100	    for src, dst in pairs:
101	        for ep in (src, dst):
102	            if ep in seen:
103	                raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
104	                    f"路径 {ep} 在重命名映射中被重复使用",
105	                    details={"reason": "rename_duplicate", "path": ep},
106	                )
107	            seen.add(ep)
108	
109	    # 端点两两之间子树不得重叠，否则同一路径被隐式映射两次。
110	    ordered = sorted(seen, key=lambda p: ptr.parse(p))
111	    for a, b in zip(ordered, ordered[1:]):
112	        if ptr.is_under(a, b):
113	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
114	                f"重命名端点 {a} 与 {b} 的子树重叠，映射不明确",
115	                details={"reason": "rename_overlapping", "paths": [a, b]},
116	            )
117	
118	    # 3) 跨版本一致性：起点不应仍在候选版本、终点不应已在基线版本。
119	    for src, dst in pairs:
120	        if src in new_fields:
121	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
122	                f"重命名起点 {src} 仍存在于候选版本，映射跨版本不一致",
123	                details={"reason": "rename_cross_version_inconsistent", "path": src},
124	            )
125	        if dst in old_fields:
126	            raise SchemaComparisonInvalid(
127	                f"重命名终点 {dst} 已存在于基线版本，映射跨版本不一致",
128	                details={"reason": "rename_cross_version_inconsistent", "path": dst},
129	            )
130	
131	    return pairs
132

136	    compatibility: str,
137	    old_path: str | None,
138	    new_path: str | None,
139	    old_schema: dict | None,
140	    new_schema: dict | None,

143	    return {
144	        "path": new_path if new_path is not None else old_path,
145	        "old_path": old_path,
146	        "new_path": new_path,
147	        "old_summary": _summary(old_schema) if old_schema is not None else None,
148	        "new_summary": _summary(new_schema) if new_schema is not None else None,

150	        "compatibility": compatibility,
