158	) -> tuple[str, str] | None:
159	    """比较两侧对齐的同字段，返回 (change_kind, compatibility) 或 None。"""
160	    old_s, new_s = old_field.schema, new_field.schema
161	    struct_changed = sf.structural_signature(old_s) != sf.structural_signature(new_s)
162	
163	    if not struct_changed:
164	        if old_required == new_required:
165	            annotation_changed = (
166	                sf.annotation_signature(old_s) != sf.annotation_signature(new_s)
167	            )
168	            return (METADATA, METADATA_COMPAT) if annotation_changed else None
169	        if new_required:
170	            return REQUIRED_ADDED, BREAKING
171	        return REQUIRED_REMOVED, COMPATIBLE
172	
173	    verdict = sf.classify_pair(old_s, new_s)
174	    if new_required and not old_required:
175	        verdict = BREAKING  # 结构变化与新增必填同时发生，取更严格结论
176	    return MODIFIED, verdict

179	def build_report(
180	    registry: Registry,
181	    name: str,
182	    baseline_version: str,
183	    candidate_document: Any,
184	    candidate_version: str | None,
185	    renames: list | None,
186	) -> dict[str, Any]:
187	    """构造字段级变更报告（不读取候选注册内容、不改动任何注册数据）。"""
188	    from .impact import analyze_field
189	
190	    old_doc = registry.get_schema(name, baseline_version).document
191	
192	    old_fields = sf.expand(old_doc)
193	    new_fields = sf.expand(candidate_document)
194	    if len(old_fields) > limits.MAX_FIELDS or len(new_fields) > limits.MAX_FIELDS:
195	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
196	            "分析对象字段数量超过公开限制",
197	            details={
198	                "reason": "fields_exceeded",
199	                "limit": limits.MAX_FIELDS,
200	                "baseline_fields": len(old_fields),
201	                "candidate_fields": len(new_fields),
202	            },
203	        )
204	    old_required = _required_set(old_fields)
205	    new_required = _required_set(new_fields)
206	
207	    pairs = validate_renames(renames, old_fields, new_fields)
208	    rename_srcs = dict(pairs)
209	    rename_dsts = {d: s for s, d in pairs}
210	
211	    def in_rename_subtree(path: str, roots: dict[str, str]) -> str | None:
212	        """返回包含该路径的重命名根（路径按段序排序，最近的根唯一）。"""
213	        segs = ptr.parse(path)
214	        best = None
215	        for root in roots:
216	            rsegs = ptr.parse(root)
217	            if len(rsegs) <= len(segs) and segs[: len(rsegs)] == rsegs:
218	                if best is None or len(rsegs) > len(ptr.parse(best)):
219	                    best = root
220	        return best
221	
222	    # 重命名子树对齐：old 后缀路径 -> new 后缀路径（仅当两侧都存在）。
223	    aligned_old: dict[str, str] = {}
224	    aligned_new: dict[str, str] = {}

227	        for p in old_fields:

234	                aligned_new[q] = p
235	
236	    changes: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
237	
238	    def impacts_for(old_path: str) -> dict:
239	        return analyze_field(registry, name, baseline_version, old_path)
240	
241	    # 1) 重命名根：每条映射恰好一条 rename（不再计删除+新增）。
242	    for src, dst in sorted(pairs):
243	        changes.append(
244	            _entry(
245	                RENAMED,
246	                BREAKING,
247	                src,
248	                dst,
249	                old_fields[src].schema,
250	                new_fields[dst].schema,
251	                impacts_for(src),
252	            )
253	        )
254	
255	    # 2) 旧侧：子树对齐字段做配对比较；其余旧侧独有路径为 deleted。
256	    for p in sorted(old_fields, key=lambda x: ptr.parse(x)):
257	        if p in rename_srcs:
258	            continue
259	        if in_rename_subtree(p, rename_srcs) is not None:
260	            q = aligned_old.get(p)
261	            if q is None:
262	                changes.append(
263	                    _entry(
264	                        DELETED, BREAKING, p, None,
265	                        old_fields[p].schema, None, impacts_for(p),
266	                    )
267	                )
268	            else:
269	                decision = _compare_matched(
270	                    old_fields[p], new_fields[q], p in old_required, q in new_required
271	                )
272	                if decision is not None:
273	                    changes.append(
274	                        _entry(
275	                            decision[0], decision[1], p, q,
276	                            old_fields[p].schema, new_fields[q].schema,
277	                            impacts_for(p),
278	                        )
279	                    )
280	            continue
281	        if p in new_fields:
282	            continue  # 公共路径，第 4 步处理
283	        changes.append(
284	            _entry(
285	                DELETED, BREAKING, p, None,
286	                old_fields[p].schema, None, impacts_for(p),
287	            )
288	        )
289	
290	    # 3) 新侧：重命名子树中未覆盖的新路径与其余新侧独有路径为 added。
291	    for q in sorted(new_fields, key=lambda x: ptr.parse(x)):
292	        if q in rename_dsts:
293	            continue
294	        if in_rename_subtree(q, rename_dsts) is not None:
295	            if q in aligned_new:
296	                continue  # 已在第 2 步配对比较
297	        elif q in old_fields:
298	            continue  # 公共路径，第 4 步处理
299	        changes.append(
300	            _entry(
301	                ADDED,
302	                BREAKING if q in new_required else COMPATIBLE,
303	                None,
304	                q,
305	                None,
306	                new_fields[q].schema,
307	                None,
308	            )
309	        )
310	
311	    # 4) 非重命名公共路径。
312	    for p in sorted(old_fields, key=lambda x: ptr.parse(x)):
313	        if p in rename_srcs or in_rename_subtree(p, rename_srcs) is not None:
314	            continue
315	        if p not in new_fields:
316	            continue
317	        decision = _compare_matched(
318	            old_fields[p], new_fields[p], p in old_required, p in new_required
319	        )
320	        if decision is not None:
321	            changes.append(
322	                _entry(
323	                    decision[0], decision[1], p, p,
324	                    old_fields[p].schema, new_fields[p].schema, impacts_for(p),
325	                )
326	            )
327	
328	    if len(changes) > limits.MAX_CHANGES:
329	        raise ImpactAnalysisTooLarge(
330	            "变更条目数量超过公开限制",
331	            details={"reason": "changes_exceeded", "limit": limits.MAX_CHANGES},
332	        )
333	
334	    # 确定性排序：按展示路径段、路径文本、变更种类。
335	    changes.sort(
336	        key=lambda e: (
337	            ptr.parse(e["path"]),
338	            e["path"],
339	            e["change_kind"],
340	            e["old_path"] or "",
341	        )
342	    )
343	
344	    counts = {BREAKING: 0, COMPATIBLE: 0, METADATA_COMPAT: 0}
345	    for e in changes:
346	        counts[e["compatibility"]] += 1
347	
348	    canonical = json.dumps(
349	        {
350	            "schema": name,
351	            "baseline_version": baseline_version,
352	            "candidate_version": candidate_version,
353	            "candidate_document": candidate_document,
354	            "renames": sorted(pairs),
355	        },
356	        sort_keys=True,
357	        ensure_ascii=False,
358	        separators=(",", ":"),
359	    )
360	    report_id = hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:16]
361	
362	    return {
363	        "report_id": report_id,
364	        "schema": name,
365	        "baseline_version": baseline_version,
366	        "candidate_version": candidate_version,
367	        "renames": [{"from": s, "to": d} for s, d in sorted(pairs)],
368	        "summary": {
369	            "total": len(changes),
370	            "breaking": counts[BREAKING],
371	            "compatible": counts[COMPATIBLE],
372	            "metadata": counts[METADATA_COMPAT],
373	        },
374	        "changes": changes,
375	    }

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段不是进入目标文档的合法字段指针；
  * ``missing_field``   片段可解析为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不可达
                        （沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转，引用环按实际引用位点
                        访问一次后终止）。

字段路径口径与 :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致：根路径为空串、数组元素为
``-``、``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、
排序与结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import Registry, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        versions = registry.list_versions(name)
        return [(name, v) for v in versions]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_source(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """源位点文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径（与注册期口径一致）。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _classify(
    registry: Registry, target: str, target_version: str, raw_fragment: str
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """返回 ``(status, target_path)``；target_path 为稳定的逻辑/规整路径。"""
    if not registry.has_schema(target, target_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA, ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw_fragment)

    document = registry.get_schema(target, target_version).document
    logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_fragment)
    if logical is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER, ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw_fragment)
    if registry.field_reachable(target, target_version, logical):
        return RESOLVED, logical
    return MISSING_FIELD, logical


def _message(status: str, target: str, version: str, raw_fragment: str, path: str) -> str:
    where = f"{target}@{version}{raw_fragment}"
    if status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {target}@{version} 未注册"
    if status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的指针片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    if status == MISSING_FIELD:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {path} 在目标版本中不可达"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 可解析"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)

    references: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        for edge in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            status, target_path = _classify(
                registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, edge.dst_path
            )
            source_path = _logical_source(document, edge.src_path)
            key = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                source_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                target_path,
            )
            if key in seen:
                if status != RESOLVED:
                    unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            references.append(
                {
                    "source_schema": src_name,
                    "source_version": src_version,
                    "source_path": source_path,
                    "target_schema": edge.dst_schema,
                    "target_version": edge.dst_version,
                    "target_path": target_path,
                    "status": status,
                }
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & set(sources))

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": ref["source_schema"],
            "source_version": ref["source_version"],
            "source_path": ref["source_path"],
            "target_schema": ref["target_schema"],
            "target_version": ref["target_version"],
            "target_path": ref["target_path"],
            "reason": ref["status"],
            "message": _message(
                ref["status"],
                ref["target_schema"],
                ref["target_version"],
                # 原始片段仅用于可读消息；规整后的逻辑路径同样给出。
                ref["target_path"],
                ref["target_path"],
            ),
        }
        for ref in references
        if ref["status"] != RESOLVED
    ]
    issues.sort(
        key=lambda i: (
            i["source_schema"],
            i["source_version"],
            tuple(ptr.parse(i["source_path"])),
            i["source_path"],
            i["target_schema"],
            i["target_version"],
            tuple(ptr.parse(i["target_path"])),
            i["target_path"],
        )
    )

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段无法结合目标文档解释为字段指针；
  * ``missing_field``   片段可解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不可达
                        （沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转，引用环按实际引用位点
                        访问一次后终止）。

字段路径口径与 :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致：根路径为空串、数组元素为
``-``、``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、
排序与结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import Registry, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Finding:
    source_schema: str
    source_version: str
    source_path: str
    target_schema: str
    target_version: str
    target_path: str
    target_fragment: str
    status: str


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_source(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """源位点文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径（与注册期口径一致）。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _classify(
    registry: Registry, target: str, target_version: str, fragment: str
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """返回 ``(status, target_path)``。"""
    if not registry.has_schema(target, target_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA, ptr.normalize_field_pointer(fragment)

    document = registry.get_schema(target, target_version).document
    logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, fragment)
    if logical is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER, ptr.normalize_field_pointer(fragment)
    if registry.field_reachable(target, target_version, logical):
        return RESOLVED, logical
    return MISSING_FIELD, logical


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
    source_set = set(sources)

    findings: list[_Finding] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        for edge in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            status, target_path = _classify(
                registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, edge.dst_path
            )
            source_path = _logical_source(document, edge.src_path)
            identity = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                source_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                target_path,
            )
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            findings.append(
                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    source_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    target_path,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "status": f.status,
        }
        for f in findings
    ]

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "reason": f.status,
            "message": _message(f),
        }
        for f in findings
        if f.status != RESOLVED
    ]
    # 按定位字段稳定排序（路径先按段序、再按文本，与其余分析口径一致）。
    issues.sort(
        key=lambda i: (
            i["source_schema"],
            i["source_version"],
            tuple(ptr.parse(i["source_path"])),
            i["source_path"],
            i["target_schema"],
            i["target_version"],
            tuple(ptr.parse(i["target_path"])),
            i["target_path"],
        )
    )

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段无法在目标文档中合法取值或不能
                        解释为字段指针；
  * ``missing_field``   片段合法且可解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不
                        可达。可达性沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析，与
                        :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 同口径；引用环按实际引用
                        位点访问一次后终止。

字段路径口径与 :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致：根路径为空串、数组元素为
``-``、``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、
排序与结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr, schema_fields as sf
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import RefEdge, Registry, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Edge:
    """逻辑化后的跨 Schema 引用边（两端均按当前文档重新解析）。"""

    src_schema: str
    src_version: str
    src_path: str
    dst_schema: str
    dst_version: str
    dst_path: str
    fragment: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Finding:
    source_schema: str
    source_version: str
    source_path: str
    target_schema: str
    target_version: str
    target_path: str
    target_fragment: str
    status: str


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_path(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径；无法结构化解析时退回无上下文规整。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _build_edges(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]]:
    """从不可变注册文档重新提取并逻辑化全部跨 Schema 引用边。

    前向引用在注册期只能按文本规整目标路径；审计时目标通常已注册，这里
    结合两端当前文档重新解析，使可达性判定与引用书写顺序无关。
    """
    out: dict[tuple[str, str], list[_Edge]] = {}
    for src_name, src_version in registry.registered_pairs():
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        edges: list[_Edge] = []
        raw: RefEdge
        for raw in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            if registry.has_schema(raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version):
                dst_doc = registry.get_schema(
                    raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version
                ).document
                dst_path = _logical_path(dst_doc, raw.dst_path)
            else:
                dst_path = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw.dst_path)
            edges.append(
                _Edge(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    _logical_path(document, raw.src_path),
                    raw.dst_schema,
                    raw.dst_version,
                    dst_path,
                    raw.dst_path,
                )
            )
        out[(src_name, src_version)] = tuple(edges)
    return out


def _field_exists(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
    document = registry.get_schema(schema, version).document
    return path in sf.expand(document)


def _reachable(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    schema: str,
    version: str,
    path: str,
) -> bool:
    """逻辑字段路径是否可达：自身为字段，或沿覆盖当前路径前缀的出边跳转可达。

    遍历与 :func:`meta_catalog.impact.forward_reach` 同口径（全部前缀匹配
    出边、后缀对齐），状态 ``(Schema, 版本, 路径)`` 只访问一次，因此引用环
    按实际引用位点判断一次后终止。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(schema, version):
        return False
    if _field_exists(registry, schema, version, path):
        return True

    visited: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = {(schema, version, path)}
    queue: deque[tuple[str, str, str]] = deque([(schema, version, path)])
    while queue:
        cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path = queue.popleft()
        cur_segs = ptr.parse(cur_path)
        for edge in edges.get((cur_schema, cur_version), ()):
            edge_segs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
            if not (
                len(edge_segs) <= len(cur_segs)
                and cur_segs[: len(edge_segs)] == edge_segs
            ):
                continue
            suffix = cur_segs[len(edge_segs) :]
            mapped = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
            state = (edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped)
            if state in visited or not registry.has_schema(
                edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version
            ):
                continue
            if _field_exists(registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped):
                return True
            visited.add(state)
            queue.append(state)
    return False


def _classify(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    edge: _Edge,
) -> str:
    """判定单条引用边状态。

    顺序：目标版本不存在 -> ``missing_schema``；片段无法在目标文档中合法
    取值（非法指针/缺段/越界/穿过非容器节点）或不能解释为字段指针 ->
    ``invalid_pointer``；逻辑字段不可达 -> ``missing_field``；否则
    ``resolved``。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA

    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
    try:
        ptr.resolve(document, edge.fragment)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if ptr.resolve_logical(document, edge.fragment) is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER

    if _reachable(
        registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, edge.dst_path
    ):
        return RESOLVED
    return MISSING_FIELD


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
    source_set = set(sources)
    edges = _build_edges(registry)

    findings: list[_Finding] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        for edge in edges.get((src_name, src_version), ()):
            status = _classify(registry, edges, edge)
            identity = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                edge.src_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                edge.dst_path,
            )
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            findings.append(
                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    edge.src_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    edge.fragment,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    # 逻辑化后按定位六元组稳定排序，去重与书写位置无关。
    findings.sort(
        key=lambda f: (
            f.source_schema,
            f.source_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.source_path)),
            f.source_path,
            f.target_schema,
            f.target_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.target_path)),
            f.target_path,
        )
    )

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "status": f.status,
        }
        for f in findings
    ]

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "reason": f.status,
            "message": _message(f),
        }
        for f in findings
        if f.status != RESOLVED
    ]

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }

    )


def _build_edges(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]]:
    """从不可变注册文档重新提取并逻辑化全部跨 Schema 引用边。

    前向引用在注册期只能按文本规整目标路径；审计时目标通常已注册，这里
    结合两端当前文档重新解析，使可达性判定与引用书写顺序无关。
    """
    out: dict[tuple[str, str], list[_Edge]] = {}
    for src_name, src_version in registry.registered_pairs():
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        edges: list[_Edge] = []
        raw: RefEdge
        for raw in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            if registry.has_schema(raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version):
                dst_doc = registry.get_schema(
                    raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version
                ).document
                dst_path = _logical_path(dst_doc, raw.dst_path)
            else:
                dst_path = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw.dst_path)
            edges.append(
                _Edge(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    _logical_path(document, raw.src_path),
                    raw.dst_schema,
                    raw.dst_version,
                    dst_path,
                    raw.dst_path,
                )
            )
        out[(src_name, src_version)] = tuple(edges)
    return out


def _field_exists(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
    document = registry.get_schema(schema, version).document
    return path in sf.expand(document)


def _reachable(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    schema: str,
    version: str,
    path: str,
) -> bool:
    """逻辑字段路径是否可达：自身为字段，或沿覆盖当前路径前缀的出边跳转可达。

    遍历与 :func:`meta_catalog.impact.forward_reach` 同口径（全部前缀匹配
    出边、后缀对齐），状态 ``(Schema, 版本, 路径)`` 只访问一次，因此引用环
    按实际引用位点判断一次后终止。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(schema, version):
        return False
    if _field_exists(registry, schema, version, path):
        return True

    visited: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = {(schema, version, path)}
    queue: deque[tuple[str, str, str]] = deque([(schema, version, path)])
    while queue:
        cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path = queue.popleft()
        cur_segs = ptr.parse(cur_path)
        for edge in edges.get((cur_schema, cur_version), ()):
            edge_segs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
            if not (
                len(edge_segs) <= len(cur_segs)
                and cur_segs[: len(edge_segs)] == edge_segs
            ):
                continue
            suffix = cur_segs[len(edge_segs) :]
            mapped = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
            state = (edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped)
            if state in visited or not registry.has_schema(
                edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version
            ):
                continue
            if _field_exists(registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped):
                return True
            visited.add(state)
            queue.append(state)
    return False


def _classify(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    edge: _Edge,
) -> str:
    """判定单条引用边状态。

    顺序：目标版本不存在 -> ``missing_schema``；片段无法在目标文档中合法
    取值（非法指针/缺段/越界/穿过非容器节点）或不能解释为字段指针 ->
    ``invalid_pointer``；逻辑字段不可达 -> ``missing_field``；否则
    ``resolved``。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA

    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
    try:
        ptr.resolve(document, edge.fragment)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if ptr.resolve_logical(document, edge.fragment) is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER

    if _reachable(
        registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, edge.dst_path
    ):
        return RESOLVED
    return MISSING_FIELD


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
    source_set = set(sources)
    edges = _build_edges(registry)

    findings: list[_Finding] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        for edge in edges.get((src_name, src_version), ()):
            status = _classify(registry, edges, edge)
            identity = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                edge.src_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                edge.dst_path,
            )
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            findings.append(
                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    edge.src_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    edge.fragment,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    # 逻辑化后按定位六元组稳定排序，去重与书写位置无关。
    findings.sort(
        key=lambda f: (
            f.source_schema,
            f.source_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.source_path)),
            f.source_path,
            f.target_schema,
            f.target_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.target_path)),
            f.target_path,
        )
    )

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "status": f.status,
        }
        for f in findings
    ]

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "reason": f.status,
            "message": _message(f),
        }
        for f in findings
        if f.status != RESOLVED
    ]

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段无法结合目标文档解释为字段指针；
  * ``missing_field``   片段可解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不可达
                        （沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转，引用环按实际引用位点
                        访问一次后终止）。

字段路径口径与 :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致：根路径为空串、数组元素为
``-``、``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、
排序与结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import Registry, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Finding:
    source_schema: str
    source_version: str
    source_path: str
    target_schema: str
    target_version: str
    target_path: str
    target_fragment: str
    status: str


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_source(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """源位点文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径（与注册期口径一致）。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _classify(
    registry: Registry, target: str, target_version: str, fragment: str
) -> tuple[str, str]:
    """返回 ``(status, target_path)``。

    判定顺序：目标版本不存在 -> ``missing_schema``；片段无法在目标文档中
    合法取值（非法 JSON Pointer / 缺段 / 越界 / 穿过非容器节点）->
    ``invalid_pointer``；片段合法但解释出的逻辑字段路径不可达（沿跨
    Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转、环处终止）-> ``missing_field``；否则
    ``resolved``。
    """
    normalized = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(fragment)
    if not registry.has_schema(target, target_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA, normalized

    document = registry.get_schema(target, target_version).document
    try:
        ptr.resolve(document, fragment)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return INVALID_POINTER, normalized

    logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, fragment)
    if logical is None:
        # 片段能取到文档节点，但落点不是字段（如 /properties、/required/0）。
        return INVALID_POINTER, normalized
    if registry.field_reachable(target, target_version, logical):
        return RESOLVED, logical
    return MISSING_FIELD, logical


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
    source_set = set(sources)

    findings: list[_Finding] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        for edge in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            status, target_path = _classify(
                registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, edge.dst_path
            )
            source_path = _logical_source(document, edge.src_path)
            identity = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                source_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                target_path,
            )
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            findings.append(
                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    source_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    target_path,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "status": f.status,
        }
        for f in findings
    ]

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "reason": f.status,
            "message": _message(f),
        }
        for f in findings
        if f.status != RESOLVED
    ]
    # 按定位字段稳定排序（路径先按段序、再按文本，与其余分析口径一致）。
    issues.sort(
        key=lambda i: (
            i["source_schema"],
            i["source_version"],
            tuple(ptr.parse(i["source_path"])),
            i["source_path"],
            i["target_schema"],
            i["target_version"],
            tuple(ptr.parse(i["target_path"])),
            i["target_path"],
        )
    )

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }

def _classify(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    edge: _Edge,
) -> str:
    """判定单条引用边状态。

    顺序：目标版本不存在 -> ``missing_schema``；片段无法结合目标文档解释
    为字段指针（非法 JSON Pointer、缺段、越界或落在非字段关键字上）->
    ``invalid_pointer``；解释出的逻辑字段不可达（沿跨 Schema ``$ref``
    边跳转、环处终止）-> ``missing_field``；否则 ``resolved``。

    前两档与注册期既有校验口径一致（``resolve_logical`` 不可解析即为
    非法引用），第三档补上跨边可达性。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA

    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
    try:
        logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, edge.fragment)
    except ValueError:
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if logical is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if _reachable(registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, logical):
        return RESOLVED
    return MISSING_FIELD

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段无法在目标文档中合法取值或不能
                        解释为字段指针；
  * ``missing_field``   片段合法且可解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不
                        可达。可达性沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析，与
                        :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 同口径；引用环按实际引用
                        位点访问一次后终止。

字段路径口径与 :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致：根路径为空串、数组元素为
``-``、``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、
排序与结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr, schema_fields as sf
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import RefEdge, Registry, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Edge:
    """逻辑化后的跨 Schema 引用边（两端均按当前文档重新解析）。"""

    src_schema: str
    src_version: str
    src_path: str
    dst_schema: str
    dst_version: str
    dst_path: str
    fragment: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Finding:
    source_schema: str
    source_version: str
    source_path: str
    target_schema: str
    target_version: str
    target_path: str
    target_fragment: str
    status: str


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_path(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径；无法结构化解析时退回无上下文规整。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _build_edges(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]]:
    """从不可变注册文档重新提取并逻辑化全部跨 Schema 引用边。

    前向引用在注册期只能按文本规整目标路径；审计时目标通常已注册，这里
    结合两端当前文档重新解析，使可达性判定与引用书写顺序无关。
    """
    out: dict[tuple[str, str], list[_Edge]] = {}
    for src_name, src_version in registry.registered_pairs():
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        edges: list[_Edge] = []
        raw: RefEdge
        for raw in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            if registry.has_schema(raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version):
                dst_doc = registry.get_schema(
                    raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version
                ).document
                dst_path = _logical_path(dst_doc, raw.dst_path)
            else:
                dst_path = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw.dst_path)
            edges.append(
                _Edge(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    _logical_path(document, raw.src_path),
                    raw.dst_schema,
                    raw.dst_version,
                    dst_path,
                    raw.dst_path,
                )
            )
        out[(src_name, src_version)] = tuple(edges)
    return out


def _field_exists(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
    document = registry.get_schema(schema, version).document
    return path in sf.expand(document)


def _reachable(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    schema: str,
    version: str,
    path: str,
) -> bool:
    """逻辑字段路径是否可达：自身为字段，或沿覆盖当前路径前缀的出边跳转可达。

    遍历与 :func:`meta_catalog.impact.forward_reach` 同口径（全部前缀匹配
    出边、后缀对齐），状态 ``(Schema, 版本, 路径)`` 只访问一次，因此引用环
    按实际引用位点判断一次后终止。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(schema, version):
        return False
    if _field_exists(registry, schema, version, path):
        return True

    visited: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = {(schema, version, path)}
    queue: deque[tuple[str, str, str]] = deque([(schema, version, path)])
    while queue:
        cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path = queue.popleft()
        cur_segs = ptr.parse(cur_path)
        for edge in edges.get((cur_schema, cur_version), ()):
            edge_segs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
            if not (
                len(edge_segs) <= len(cur_segs)
                and cur_segs[: len(edge_segs)] == edge_segs
            ):
                continue
            suffix = cur_segs[len(edge_segs) :]
            mapped = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
            state = (edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped)
            if state in visited or not registry.has_schema(
                edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version
            ):
                continue
            if _field_exists(registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped):
                return True
            visited.add(state)
            queue.append(state)
    return False


def _classify(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    edge: _Edge,
) -> str:
    """判定单条引用边状态。

    顺序：目标版本不存在 -> ``missing_schema``；片段无法在目标文档中合法
    取值（非法指针/缺段/越界/穿过非容器节点）或不能解释为字段指针 ->
    ``invalid_pointer``；逻辑字段不可达 -> ``missing_field``；否则
    ``resolved``。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA

    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
    try:
        ptr.resolve(document, edge.fragment)
    except (KeyError, ValueError):
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if ptr.resolve_logical(document, edge.fragment) is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER

    if _reachable(
        registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, edge.dst_path
    ):
        return RESOLVED
    return MISSING_FIELD


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
    source_set = set(sources)
    edges = _build_edges(registry)

    findings: list[_Finding] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        for edge in edges.get((src_name, src_version), ()):
            status = _classify(registry, edges, edge)
            identity = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                edge.src_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                edge.dst_path,
            )
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            findings.append(
                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    edge.src_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    edge.fragment,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    # 逻辑化后按定位六元组稳定排序，去重与书写位置无关。
    findings.sort(
        key=lambda f: (
            f.source_schema,
            f.source_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.source_path)),
            f.source_path,
            f.target_schema,
            f.target_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.target_path)),
            f.target_path,
        )
    )

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "status": f.status,
        }
        for f in findings
    ]

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "reason": f.status,
            "message": _message(f),
        }
        for f in findings
        if f.status != RESOLVED
    ]

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段无法在目标文档中合法取值或不能
                        解释为字段指针；
  * ``missing_field``   片段合法且可解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不
                        可达。可达性沿跨 Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转解析，与
                        :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 同口径；引用环按实际引用
                        位点访问一次后终止。

字段路径口径与 :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致：根路径为空串、数组元素为
``-``、``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、
排序与结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr, schema_fields as sf
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import RefEdge, Registry, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Edge:
    """逻辑化后的跨 Schema 引用边（两端均按当前文档重新解析）。"""

    src_schema: str
    src_version: str
    src_path: str
    dst_schema: str
    dst_version: str
    dst_path: str
    fragment: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Finding:
    source_schema: str
    source_version: str
    source_path: str
    target_schema: str
    target_version: str
    target_path: str
    target_fragment: str
    status: str


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_path(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径；无法结构化解析时退回无上下文规整。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _build_edges(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]]:
    """从不可变注册文档重新提取并逻辑化全部跨 Schema 引用边。

    前向引用在注册期只能按文本规整目标路径；审计时目标通常已注册，这里
    结合两端当前文档重新解析，使可达性判定与引用书写顺序无关。
    """
    out: dict[tuple[str, str], list[_Edge]] = {}
    for src_name, src_version in registry.registered_pairs():
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        edges: list[_Edge] = []
        raw: RefEdge
        for raw in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            if registry.has_schema(raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version):
                dst_doc = registry.get_schema(
                    raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version
                ).document
                dst_path = _logical_path(dst_doc, raw.dst_path)
            else:
                dst_path = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw.dst_path)
            edges.append(
                _Edge(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    _logical_path(document, raw.src_path),
                    raw.dst_schema,
                    raw.dst_version,
                    dst_path,
                    raw.dst_path,
                )
            )
        out[(src_name, src_version)] = tuple(edges)
    return out


def _field_exists(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
    document = registry.get_schema(schema, version).document
    return path in sf.expand(document)


def _reachable(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    schema: str,
    version: str,
    path: str,
) -> bool:
    """逻辑字段路径是否可达：自身为字段，或沿覆盖当前路径前缀的出边跳转可达。

    遍历与 :func:`meta_catalog.impact.forward_reach` 同口径（全部前缀匹配
    出边、后缀对齐），状态 ``(Schema, 版本, 路径)`` 只访问一次，因此引用环
    按实际引用位点判断一次后终止。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(schema, version):
        return False
    if _field_exists(registry, schema, version, path):
        return True

    visited: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = {(schema, version, path)}
    queue: deque[tuple[str, str, str]] = deque([(schema, version, path)])
    while queue:
        cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path = queue.popleft()
        cur_segs = ptr.parse(cur_path)
        for edge in edges.get((cur_schema, cur_version), ()):
            edge_segs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
            if not (
                len(edge_segs) <= len(cur_segs)
                and cur_segs[: len(edge_segs)] == edge_segs
            ):
                continue
            suffix = cur_segs[len(edge_segs) :]
            mapped = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
            state = (edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped)
            if state in visited or not registry.has_schema(
                edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version
            ):
                continue
            if _field_exists(registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped):
                return True
            visited.add(state)
            queue.append(state)
    return False


def _classify(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    edge: _Edge,
) -> str:
    """判定单条引用边状态。

    顺序：目标版本不存在 -> ``missing_schema``；片段无法结合目标文档解释
    为字段指针（非法 JSON Pointer、缺段、越界或落在非字段关键字上）->
    ``invalid_pointer``；解释出的逻辑字段不可达（沿跨 Schema ``$ref``
    边跳转、环处终止）-> ``missing_field``；否则 ``resolved``。

    非法引用），第三档补上跨边可达性。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA

    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
    try:
        logical = ptr.resolve_logical(document, edge.fragment)
    except ValueError:
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if logical is None:
        return INVALID_POINTER
    if _reachable(registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, logical):
        return RESOLVED
    return MISSING_FIELD


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"

                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    edge.src_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    edge.fragment,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    # 逻辑化后按定位六元组稳定排序，去重与书写位置无关。
    findings.sort(

            f.source_schema,
            f.source_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.source_path)),
            f.source_path,
            f.target_schema,
            f.target_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.target_path)),
            f.target_path,
        )
    )

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,

"""跨 Schema 引用完整性审计（只读）。

审计每个已注册 Schema 版本中声明的跨 Schema ``$ref``（形如
``Name@version#pointer``），文档内 ``#/`` 引用不在审计范围内。

引用状态（``status``）：

  * ``resolved``        目标版本存在，片段对应的逻辑字段可达；
  * ``missing_schema``  目标 Schema 版本未注册（允许前向引用，注册期不报错）；
  * ``invalid_pointer`` 目标版本存在，但片段不能解释为字段指针（容器关键字
                        后缺字段名、数组下标越界/非数字、穿过非 Schema 取值
                        等结构性非法情形）；
  * ``missing_field``   片段能解释为逻辑字段路径，但该字段在目标中不可达：
                        属性/定义名缺失，或既不在目标字段表中、也无法沿跨
                        Schema ``$ref`` 边跳转到达。可达性口径与
                        :mod:`meta_catalog.impact` 一致，引用环按实际引用
                        位点访问一次后终止。

字段路径口径同样沿用影响分析：根路径为空串、数组元素为 ``-``、
``additionalProperties`` 为 ``*``。相同输入始终给出相同的统计、排序与
结论；审计不改动注册内容、不写入检索索引。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from collections import deque
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Any

from . import pointer as ptr, schema_fields as sf
from .errors import NotFoundError
from .registry import RefEdge, Registry, parse_external_ref, extract_ref_edges

RESOLVED = "resolved"
MISSING_SCHEMA = "missing_schema"
MISSING_FIELD = "missing_field"
INVALID_POINTER = "invalid_pointer"

# 结构解释结果：
#   ("field", logical_path)   片段完整落在某个字段节点上
#   ("missing", logical_path) 片段意图指向某字段，但字段在文档中缺失
#   ("edge", logical_path)    停在外部 $ref 节点上，剩余片段需跨边继续
#   ("invalid", None)         片段结构性非法，不构成字段指针
_FIELD = "field"
_MISSING = "missing"
_EDGE = "edge"
_INVALID = "invalid"


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Edge:
    """逻辑化后的跨 Schema 引用边（两端均按当前文档重新解析）。"""

    src_schema: str
    src_version: str
    src_path: str
    dst_schema: str
    dst_version: str
    dst_path: str
    fragment: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class _Finding:
    source_schema: str
    source_version: str
    source_path: str
    target_schema: str
    target_version: str
    target_path: str
    target_fragment: str
    status: str


def _select_sources(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None, version: str | None
) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    """按参数语义选出受审的 ``(名称, 版本)``，保持注册顺序；无匹配抛 NotFound。"""
    pairs = registry.registered_pairs()
    if name is not None and version is not None:
        if not registry.has_schema(name, version):
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"Schema {name}@{version} 不存在",
                details={"schema": name, "version": version},
            )
        return [(name, version)]
    if name is not None:
        # name 不存在时 list_versions 抛 NotFoundError。
        return [(name, v) for v in registry.list_versions(name)]
    if version is not None:
        matched = [(n, v) for n, v in pairs if v == version]
        if not matched:
            raise NotFoundError(
                f"版本 {version} 下没有已注册的 Schema",
                details={"version": version},
            )
        return matched
    return list(pairs)


def _logical_path(document: Any, raw_path: str) -> str:
    """文档指针 -> 逻辑字段路径；无法结构化解析时退回无上下文规整。"""
    return ptr.resolve_logical(document, raw_path) or ptr.normalize_field_pointer(
        raw_path
    )


def _build_edges(registry: Registry) -> dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]]:
    """从不可变注册文档重新提取并逻辑化全部跨 Schema 引用边。

    前向引用在注册期只能按文本规整目标路径；审计时目标通常已注册，这里
    结合两端当前文档重新解析，使可达性判定与引用书写顺序无关。
    """
    out: dict[tuple[str, str], list[_Edge]] = {}
    for src_name, src_version in registry.registered_pairs():
        document = registry.get_schema(src_name, src_version).document
        edges: list[_Edge] = []
        raw: RefEdge
        for raw in extract_ref_edges(src_name, src_version, document):
            if registry.has_schema(raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version):
                dst_doc = registry.get_schema(
                    raw.dst_schema, raw.dst_version
                ).document
                dst_path = _logical_path(dst_doc, raw.dst_path)
            else:
                dst_path = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(raw.dst_path)
            edges.append(
                _Edge(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    _logical_path(document, raw.src_path),
                    raw.dst_schema,
                    raw.dst_version,
                    dst_path,
                    raw.dst_path,
                )
            )
        out[(src_name, src_version)] = tuple(edges)
    return out


def _external_ref(node: Any) -> tuple[str, str, str] | None:
    if isinstance(node, dict) and isinstance(node.get("$ref"), str):
        return parse_external_ref(node["$ref"])
    return None


def _interpret(document: Any, fragment: str) -> tuple[str, str | None]:
    """把原始片段结合目标文档结构解释为逻辑字段路径。

    规则与 :func:`meta_catalog.pointer.resolve_logical` 的字段展开口径一致，
    但对「字段缺失」与「片段结构性非法」加以区分，并在停于外部 ``$ref``
    节点时提示调用方沿跨 Schema 边继续解析。
    """
    try:
        segs = ptr.parse(fragment)
    except ValueError:
        return _INVALID, None

    node: Any = document
    logical: list[str] = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(segs):
        seg = segs[i]

        if isinstance(node, bool) or not isinstance(node, (dict, list)):
            # 穿过叶子 Schema/标量继续取段：字段不可达（非结构性非法）。
            return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [seg] + list(segs[i + 1 :]))

        if isinstance(node, list):
            try:
                idx = int(seg)
            except ValueError:
                return _INVALID, None
            if not 0 <= idx < len(node):
                return _INVALID, None
            node = node[idx]
            logical.append(seg)
            i += 1
            continue

        # 停在外部 $ref 节点上、仍有后续段：交由边跳转解析。
        if _external_ref(node) is not None:
            suffix = ptr.normalize_field_pointer(ptr.format(segs[i:]))
            return _EDGE, ptr.format(list(logical) + list(ptr.parse(suffix)))

        props = node.get("properties")
        if seg == "properties":
            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(props, dict):
                return _INVALID, None
            name = segs[i + 1]
            if name not in props:
                return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [name])
            node = props[name]
            logical.append(name)
            i += 2
            continue

        pats = node.get("patternProperties")
        if seg == "patternProperties":
            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(pats, dict):
                return _INVALID, None
            name = segs[i + 1]
            if name not in pats:
                return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [ptr.escape(name)])
            node = pats[name]
            logical.append(ptr.escape(name))
            i += 2
            continue

        ap = node.get("additionalProperties")
        if seg == "additionalProperties":
            if isinstance(ap, dict):
                node = ap
                logical.append("*")
                i += 1
                continue
            return _INVALID, None

        items = node.get("items")
        if seg == "items":
            if isinstance(items, dict):
                node = items
                logical.append("-")
                i += 1
                continue
            if isinstance(items, list):
                if i + 1 >= len(segs):
                    return _INVALID, None
                raw_idx = segs[i + 1]
                try:
                    idx = int(raw_idx)
                except ValueError:
                    return _INVALID, None
                if not 0 <= idx < len(items):
                    return _INVALID, None
                node = items[idx]
                logical.append(raw_idx)
                i += 2
                continue
            return _INVALID, None

        pre = node.get("prefixItems")
        if seg == "prefixItems":
            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(pre, list):
                return _INVALID, None
            raw_idx = segs[i + 1]
            try:
                idx = int(raw_idx)
            except ValueError:
                return _INVALID, None
            if not 0 <= idx < len(pre):
                return _INVALID, None
            node = pre[idx]
            logical.append(raw_idx)
            i += 2
            continue

        if seg in ("$defs", "definitions"):
            defs = node.get(seg)
            if i + 1 >= len(segs) or not isinstance(defs, dict):
                return _INVALID, None
            name = segs[i + 1]
            if name not in defs:
                return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [seg, name])
            node = defs[name]
            logical.extend((seg, name))
            i += 2
            continue

        # 其余段：键存在则继续下沉；落在非 Schema 取值上为非法。
        if seg not in node:
            # 兼容直接书写逻辑路径（/name）与未知名：先按候选字段处理，
            # 最终由字段表/跨边可达性裁决。
            return _MISSING, ptr.format(logical + [seg] + list(segs[i + 1 :]))
        node = node[seg]
        logical.append(seg)
        i += 1

    # 片段耗尽：落点必须是一个字段 Schema（dict/bool）；标量/容器关键字非法。
    if isinstance(node, (dict, bool)):
        return _FIELD, ptr.format(logical)
    return _INVALID, None


def _field_exists(registry: Registry, schema: str, version: str, path: str) -> bool:
    document = registry.get_schema(schema, version).document
    return path in sf.expand(document)


def _reachable(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    schema: str,
    version: str,
    path: str,
) -> bool:
    """逻辑字段路径是否可达：自身为字段，或沿覆盖当前路径前缀的出边跳转可达。

    遍历与 :func:`meta_catalog.impact.forward_reach` 同口径（全部前缀匹配
    出边、后缀对齐），状态 ``(Schema, 版本, 路径)`` 只访问一次，因此引用环
    按实际引用位点判断一次后终止。
    """
    if not registry.has_schema(schema, version):
        return False
    if _field_exists(registry, schema, version, path):
        return True

    visited: set[tuple[str, str, str]] = {(schema, version, path)}
    queue: deque[tuple[str, str, str]] = deque([(schema, version, path)])
    while queue:
        cur_schema, cur_version, cur_path = queue.popleft()
        cur_segs = ptr.parse(cur_path)
        for edge in edges.get((cur_schema, cur_version), ()):
            edge_segs = ptr.parse(edge.src_path)
            if not (
                len(edge_segs) <= len(cur_segs)
                and cur_segs[: len(edge_segs)] == edge_segs
            ):
                continue
            suffix = cur_segs[len(edge_segs) :]
            mapped = ptr.format(list(ptr.parse(edge.dst_path)) + list(suffix))
            state = (edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped)
            if state in visited or not registry.has_schema(
                edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version
            ):
                continue
            if _field_exists(registry, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, mapped):
                return True
            visited.add(state)
            queue.append(state)
    return False


def _classify(
    registry: Registry,
    edges: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[_Edge, ...]],
    edge: _Edge,
) -> str:
    """判定单条引用边状态。"""
    if not registry.has_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version):
        return MISSING_SCHEMA

    document = registry.get_schema(edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version).document
    kind, logical = _interpret(document, edge.fragment)
    if kind == _INVALID:
        return INVALID_POINTER
    # field / missing / edge 三种解释统一交给跨边可达性裁决。
    if _reachable(
        registry, edges, edge.dst_schema, edge.dst_version, logical or edge.dst_path
    ):
        return RESOLVED
    return MISSING_FIELD


def _message(f: _Finding) -> str:
    where = f"{f.target_schema}@{f.target_version}{f.target_fragment}"
    if f.status == MISSING_SCHEMA:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用的目标 {f.target_schema}@{f.target_version} 未注册"
    if f.status == INVALID_POINTER:
        return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的片段不是目标文档中的合法字段指针"
    return f"跨 Schema 引用 {where} 的字段路径 {f.target_path} 在目标版本中不可达"


def check_references(
    registry: Registry, name: str | None = None, version: str | None = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """审计受审 Schema 版本中的全部跨 Schema ``$ref``。"""
    sources = _select_sources(registry, name, version)
    source_set = set(sources)
    edges = _build_edges(registry)

    findings: list[_Finding] = []
    seen: set[tuple[str, str, str, str, str, str]] = set()
    unresolved_sources: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()

    for src_name, src_version in sources:
        for edge in edges.get((src_name, src_version), ()):
            status = _classify(registry, edges, edge)
            identity = (
                src_name,
                src_version,
                edge.src_path,
                edge.dst_schema,
                edge.dst_version,
                edge.dst_path,
            )
            if identity in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(identity)
            if status != RESOLVED:
                unresolved_sources.add((src_name, src_version))
            findings.append(
                _Finding(
                    src_name,
                    src_version,
                    edge.src_path,
                    edge.dst_schema,
                    edge.dst_version,
                    edge.dst_path,
                    edge.fragment,
                    status,
                )
            )

    total = len(sources)
    resolved = total - len(unresolved_sources & source_set)

    # 逻辑化后按定位六元组稳定排序，去重与书写位置无关。
    findings.sort(
        key=lambda f: (
            f.source_schema,
            f.source_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.source_path)),
            f.source_path,
            f.target_schema,
            f.target_version,
            tuple(ptr.parse(f.target_path)),
            f.target_path,
        )
    )

    references = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "status": f.status,
        }
        for f in findings
    ]

    issues = [
        {
            "source_schema": f.source_schema,
            "source_version": f.source_version,
            "source_path": f.source_path,
            "target_schema": f.target_schema,
            "target_version": f.target_version,
            "target_path": f.target_path,
            "reason": f.status,
            "message": _message(f),
        }
        for f in findings
        if f.status != RESOLVED
    ]

    return {
        "checked": total,
        "total": total,
        "resolved": resolved,
        "issues": issues,
        "references": references,
    }
